Tumor flare after bispecific antibody therapy
Supplementary analysis and publication displays

US Myeloma Immunotherapy Consortium. Tables and figures from the canonical analysis using site-reviewed EDC data as the authority for conflicting clinical findings.

Shared pipelineTable 1Table 2Table S1Table S2Table S3Table S4Table S5Figure 1Figure 2Figure 3Figure 4Figure 5Figure S1References

Shared analysis pipeline

The analysis starts with the master course cohort and site-reviewed electronic data collection forms. Site EDC findings take precedence for matching clinical concepts when sources conflict. Unknown authoritative values remain unknown; unresolved endpoints are excluded from affected models. Public case records contain only predefined categories, coded flags, and numeric elapsed times; case-level clinical prose is excluded. Symptom recovery, local lesion outcome, first post-flare response, and best index-course response are distinct outcomes.

Primary comparative analyses include site-reviewed suspected flare, including Possible cases. Higher-confidence and other prespecified sensitivities address classification and timing. Firth logistic models assess baseline and response associations. PFS and OS use time-dependent flare exposure, with day-30 and day-60 landmark sensitivities. Model populations, endpoint exclusions, covariate missingness, successful bootstrap counts, and qualifications accompany the estimates.

Published aggregate outputs regenerate the tables and figures. Generic analysis code is provided with synthetic inputs; confidential clinical source data are needed to rerun the empirical cohort analysis. Original clinical identifiers, clinical calendar dates, and case-level clinical prose are excluded. Synthetic inputs use artificial identifiers and dates.

# Portable analytical entry point. All source-specific rules are controlled data.
# Usage: Rscript run_analysis.R CONTROLLED_DATA_DIRECTORY OUTPUT_DIRECTORY [B]
args<-commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)
if(length(args)<2L)stop("Expected controlled data and output directories")
data_dir<-normalizePath(args[1],mustWork=TRUE)
output_dir<-args[2];dir.create(output_dir,recursive=TRUE,showWarnings=FALSE)
output_dir<-normalizePath(output_dir,mustWork=TRUE)
B<-if(length(args)>=3L)as.integer(args[3])else 1000L
if(!is.finite(B)||B<1L)stop("Bootstrap draw count must be positive")
RNGkind("Mersenne-Twister","Inversion","Rejection")
library_path<-Sys.getenv("TF_R_LIBRARY","")
if(nzchar(library_path)).libPaths(c(normalizePath(library_path,mustWork=TRUE),.libPaths()))
script_arg<-grep("^--file=",commandArgs(),value=TRUE)
code_dir<-dirname(normalizePath(sub("^--file=","",script_arg[1]),mustWork=TRUE))
for(file in c("analysis_functions.R","survival_functions.R","reconciliation_functions.R","model_functions.R","summary_functions.R"))source(file.path(code_dir,file))
for(package in c("dplyr","tidyr","tibble","survival","logistf","jsonlite"))if(!requireNamespace(package,quietly=TRUE))stop("Missing dependency: ",package)
master<-tf_read_controlled_csv(file.path(data_dir,"master_courses.csv"))
cases<-tf_read_controlled_csv(file.path(data_dir,"edc_cases.csv"))
rules<-utils::read.csv(file.path(data_dir,"verified_corrections.csv"),check.names=FALSE,stringsAsFactors=FALSE,na.strings="")
source_path<-file.path(data_dir,"master_source_records.csv")
master_sources<-if(file.exists(source_path))utils::read.csv(source_path,stringsAsFactors=FALSE,na.strings="")else NULL
analysis<-tf_reconcile(master,cases,rules,master_sources)
scenario_path<-file.path(data_dir,"survival_scenario_rules.csv")
analysis$survival_scenario_rules<-if(file.exists(scenario_path))utils::read.csv(scenario_path,
  check.names=FALSE,stringsAsFactors=FALSE,na.strings="")else NULL
analysis$project_root<-data_dir
counts<-sort(table(analysis$cases$site_key),decreasing=TRUE)
analysis$excluded_site_keys<-names(counts)[1]
specs<-tf_ash_specs()
ids<-character()
for(scenario in c("primary","strict","without_dominant_site")) {
  ids<-c(ids,paste(scenario,specs$field,sep="_"))
  for(threshold in c("pr","vgpr","cr"))ids<-c(ids,paste(scenario,paste0("response_",threshold),c("unadjusted","adjusted"),sep="_"))
}
seed_path<-file.path(data_dir,"model_seed_manifest.csv")
if(!file.exists(seed_path))seed_path<-file.path(code_dir,"model_seed_manifest.csv")
if(file.exists(seed_path)) {
  seeds<-utils::read.csv(seed_path,stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  if(!setequal(ids,seeds$model_id)||anyDuplicated(seeds$model_id)||anyNA(seeds$seed))stop("Model seed manifest does not match requested models")
} else stop("A fixed model-ID seed manifest is required")
analysis$model_seeds<-seeds
tf_export_descriptive(analysis,output_dir)
source(file.path(code_dir,"ground_truth_tests.R"))
checks<-tf_ground_truth_tests(master,cases,rules,analysis)
utils::write.csv(checks,file.path(output_dir,"ground_truth_verification.csv"),row.names=FALSE)
if(any(checks$status!="PASS"))stop("Ground-truth reconciliation validation failed")
cat("Reconciliation passed",nrow(checks),"checks. Starting",length(ids),"Firth models with",B,"patient-cluster draws each.\n")
models<-tf_build_ash_extension(analysis,output_dir,B=B,seed=20261106L,progress=TRUE)
tf_export_models(analysis,models,output_dir)
tf_write_analysis_summary(analysis,models,output_dir)
utils::write.csv(seeds,file.path(output_dir,"model_seed_manifest.csv"),row.names=FALSE)
writeLines(c(paste("Bootstrap draws:",B),paste("RNG:",paste(RNGkind(),collapse="; ")),
  "Canonical returned-case fields use authoritative EDC/site data, including unavailable values.",
  "No date, response, event, or covariate imputation.","",capture.output(sessionInfo())),
  file.path(output_dir,"session_info.txt"))
cat("Canonical analysis complete.\n")
analysis_functions.R
# Generic normalized-data analysis helpers.
tf_response_levels <- c("sCR","CR","VGPR","PR","MR","SD","PD","NE/Unknown","Blank")
tf_product_labels <- c(teclistamab="Teclistamab",talquetamab="Talquetamab",elranatamab="Elranatamab",linvoseltamab="Linvoseltamab")
tf_norm <- function(x) tolower(trimws(gsub("\\s+", " ", as.character(x))))

tf_number <- function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(x)))

tf_binary <- function(x) {
  z <- tf_norm(x)
  out <- rep(NA, length(z)); out[z %in% c("1", "yes", "y", "true")] <- TRUE
  out[z %in% c("0", "no", "n", "false")] <- FALSE
  out
}

tf_category <- function(x) {
  z <- if(is.logical(x)) ifelse(is.na(x),NA_character_,ifelse(x,"Yes","No")) else as.character(x)
  z[is.na(z) | trimws(z) == ""] <- "Blank"; z
}

tf_response <- function(x) {
  z <- tf_norm(x); out <- rep("NE/Unknown", length(z))
  out[is.na(z) | z == ""] <- "Blank"
  # Keep a leading formal category in an annotation without upgrading it from
  # a deeper category mentioned later. Qualified/ambiguous claims stay unknown.
  for (category in c("PD", "SD", "MR", "PR", "CR", "VGPR", "sCR")) {
    pattern <- if (category == "VGPR") "^(vgpr|vpgr)$" else paste0("^", tolower(category), "$")
    out[!is.na(z) & grepl(pattern, z)] <- category
  }
  annotated <- !is.na(z) & grepl("^(scr|cr|vgpr|vpgr|pr|mr|sd|pd)\\s*(\\(|-)",z) & !grepl("compatible|unconfirmed|possible|unclear",z)
  lead <- toupper(sub("^([a-z]+).*$","\\1",z[annotated]))
  lead[lead=="VPGR"] <- "VGPR"; lead[lead=="SCR"] <- "sCR"
  out[annotated] <- lead
  out
}

tf_incidence <- function(data, scenario, group = "product") {
  groups <- c("Overall", unname(tf_product_labels))
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(groups, function(g) {
    z <- if (g == "Overall") data else data[data$product == g, , drop = FALSE]
    n <- nrow(z); events <- sum(z$analysis_flare, na.rm = TRUE)
    ci <- if (n) stats::binom.test(events, n)$conf.int else c(NA_real_, NA_real_)
    tibble::tibble(scenario = scenario, product = g, courses = n, flare_candidates = events,
      incidence_percent = if (n) 100 * events/n else NA_real_, lower_95_percent = 100 * ci[1], upper_95_percent = 100 * ci[2])
  }))
}

tf_summary_fields <- function(data, specs, groups = c("All", "Flare candidate", "No included flare")) {
  result <- list()
  for (group in groups) {
    z <- if (group == "All") data else data[data$analysis_flare == (group == "Flare candidate"), , drop = FALSE]
    for (field in names(specs)) {
      value <- z[[field]]; label <- specs[[field]]
      if (is.numeric(value) && !inherits(value, "Date")) {
        known <- value[!is.na(value) & is.finite(value)]
        summary <- if (length(known)) sprintf("%.1f (%.1f, %.1f)", stats::median(known), stats::quantile(known, .25), stats::quantile(known, .75)) else "Unavailable"
        result[[length(result)+1L]] <- tibble::tibble(group = group, measure = label, category = "Median (IQR)", n = length(known), denominator = nrow(z), percent = NA_real_, summary = summary)
        result[[length(result)+1L]] <- tibble::tibble(group = group, measure = label, category = "Blank", n = sum(is.na(value)), denominator = nrow(z), percent = if(nrow(z)) 100*sum(is.na(value))/nrow(z) else NA_real_, summary = NA_character_)
      } else {
        counts <- table(tf_category(value))
        result[[length(result)+1L]] <- tibble::tibble(group = group, measure = label, category = names(counts), n = as.integer(counts), denominator = nrow(z), percent = if(nrow(z)) 100*as.integer(counts)/nrow(z) else NA_real_, summary = NA_character_)
      }
    }
  }
  dplyr::bind_rows(result)
}

tf_baseline_data <- function(x) x
tf_outcome_data <- function(x) x
survival_functions.R
# Survival analyses for the returned tumor-flare EDC extension.
# These functions operate on an analysis copy and never alter source workbooks.
# Required inputs are one row per course and these columns:
# course_id, patient_cluster_id, start_date, pd_date, death_date,
# last_contact_date, analysis_flare (logical), and onset_date.
# Dates must be Date, POSIXt, or ISO date strings. Exposure is an investigator-
# classified candidate flag, not a claim that the event is independently proven.

edc_survival_date <- function(x, column) {
  if (inherits(x, "Date")) return(x)
  if (inherits(x, "POSIXt")) return(as.Date(x))
  if (is.logical(x) && all(is.na(x))) return(as.Date(rep(NA_character_, length(x))))
  if (is.numeric(x)) {
    stop(column, " must be converted to Date before survival analysis; numeric date origins are not inferred.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  raw <- trimws(as.character(x))
  raw[is.na(x) | raw == ""] <- NA_character_
  out <- suppressWarnings(as.Date(raw, format = "%Y-%m-%d"))
  if (any(!is.na(raw) & (is.na(out) | !grepl("^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$", raw)))) {
    stop(column, " contains non-ISO date text; resolve it in the import layer.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  out
}

edc_validate_survival_data <- function(data) {
  required <- c("course_id", "patient_cluster_id", "start_date", "pd_date",
                "death_date", "last_contact_date", "analysis_flare", "onset_date")
  missing <- setdiff(required, names(data))
  if (length(missing)) stop("Missing survival columns: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
  data <- as.data.frame(data, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  data$course_id <- trimws(as.character(data$course_id))
  if (any(is.na(data$course_id) | data$course_id == "") || anyDuplicated(data$course_id)) {
    stop("Survival input must contain one row per nonmissing, unique course_id.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  if (!is.logical(data$analysis_flare)) stop("analysis_flare must be logical; unknown classifications must remain NA.", call. = FALSE)
  for (column in c("start_date", "pd_date", "death_date", "last_contact_date", "onset_date")) {
    data[[column]] <- edc_survival_date(data[[column]], column)
  }
  data$patient_cluster_id <- trimws(as.character(data$patient_cluster_id))
  missing_cluster <- is.na(data$patient_cluster_id) | data$patient_cluster_id == ""
  prior_fallback <- if ("cluster_fallback_to_course" %in% names(data)) data$cluster_fallback_to_course else rep(FALSE, nrow(data))
  data$cluster_fallback_to_course <- prior_fallback | missing_cluster
  data$patient_cluster_id[missing_cluster] <- paste0("unlinked_course:", data$course_id[missing_cluster])
  data
}

edc_apply_onset_overrides <- function(data, onset_overrides = NULL) {
  data <- edc_validate_survival_data(data)
  if (!"onset_date_before_override" %in% names(data)) data$onset_date_before_override <- data$onset_date
  if (!"onset_override_applied" %in% names(data)) data$onset_override_applied <- rep(FALSE, nrow(data))
  if (is.null(onset_overrides) || nrow(onset_overrides) == 0L) return(data)
  if (!all(c("course_id", "onset_date") %in% names(onset_overrides))) {
    stop("onset_overrides requires course_id and onset_date columns.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  overrides <- as.data.frame(onset_overrides, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  overrides$course_id <- as.character(overrides$course_id)
  if (anyDuplicated(overrides$course_id) || any(is.na(overrides$course_id))) {
    stop("onset_overrides must have unique, nonmissing course IDs.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  if (any(!overrides$course_id %in% data$course_id)) stop("An onset override does not match an input course.", call. = FALSE)
  overrides$onset_date <- edc_survival_date(overrides$onset_date, "onset_overrides$onset_date")
  idx <- match(overrides$course_id, data$course_id)
  if (any(is.na(data$analysis_flare[idx]) | !data$analysis_flare[idx])) {
    stop("Onset overrides can be applied only to classified flare candidates.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  data$onset_date[idx] <- overrides$onset_date
  data$onset_override_applied[idx] <- TRUE
  data
}

edc_min_date <- function(x, y) {
  out <- as.Date(rep(NA_character_, length(x)))
  both <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(y)
  out[both] <- pmin(x[both], y[both])
  out[!is.na(x) & is.na(y)] <- x[!is.na(x) & is.na(y)]
  out[is.na(x) & !is.na(y)] <- y[is.na(x) & !is.na(y)]
  out
}

edc_build_endpoint <- function(data, endpoint = c("PFS", "OS"),
                               pfs_exclude_course_ids = character(), onset_overrides = NULL) {
  endpoint <- match.arg(endpoint)
  data <- edc_apply_onset_overrides(data, onset_overrides)
  data$endpoint <- rep(endpoint, nrow(data))
  data$event_date <- if (endpoint == "PFS") edc_min_date(data$pd_date, data$death_date) else data$death_date
  data$event_after_last_contact <- !is.na(data$event_date) & !is.na(data$last_contact_date) &
    data$event_date > data$last_contact_date
  data$status <- as.integer(!is.na(data$event_date) &
    (is.na(data$last_contact_date) | data$event_date <= data$last_contact_date))
  data$observed_date <- data$last_contact_date
  data$observed_date[data$status == 1L] <- data$event_date[data$status == 1L]
  data$followup_days <- as.numeric(data$observed_date - data$start_date)
  data$time_months <- data$followup_days / 30.4375
  data$endpoint_exclusion_reason <- rep(NA_character_, nrow(data))
  reason <- function(condition, text) {
    use <- condition & is.na(data$endpoint_exclusion_reason)
    data$endpoint_exclusion_reason[use] <<- text
  }
  reason(endpoint == "PFS" & data$course_id %in% pfs_exclude_course_ids,
         "Unresolved true-progression date; excluded from primary updated PFS without an inferred event or censor date")
  reason(is.na(data$start_date), "Missing treatment-start date")
  reason(is.na(data$observed_date), "No valid endpoint observation date")
  reason(!is.na(data$followup_days) & data$followup_days < 0, "Endpoint observation precedes treatment start")
  reason(!is.na(data$followup_days) & data$followup_days == 0, "Zero follow-up; no positive survival interval")
  data$endpoint_eligible <- is.na(data$endpoint_exclusion_reason)
  audit_columns <- c("course_id", "patient_cluster_id", "endpoint", "start_date", "pd_date", "death_date",
                     "last_contact_date", "event_date", "observed_date", "status", "followup_days",
                     "endpoint_exclusion_reason")
  exclusions <- data[!data$endpoint_eligible, audit_columns, drop = FALSE]
  notes <- data[data$event_after_last_contact | data$cluster_fallback_to_course,
                c("course_id", "endpoint", "event_after_last_contact", "cluster_fallback_to_course"), drop = FALSE]
  list(data = data[data$endpoint_eligible, , drop = FALSE], exclusions = exclusions,
       audit = data, notes = notes)
}

edc_prepare_survival_timing <- function(endpoint_data) {
  data <- endpoint_data
  data$onset_day <- as.numeric(data$onset_date - data$start_date)
  data$timing_exclusion_reason <- rep(NA_character_, nrow(data))
  unknown <- is.na(data$analysis_flare)
  missing_onset <- !unknown & data$analysis_flare & is.na(data$onset_day)
  before_start <- !unknown & data$analysis_flare & !is.na(data$onset_day) & data$onset_day < 0
  data$timing_exclusion_reason[unknown] <- "Unknown flare classification; not assigned to the no-flare group"
  data$timing_exclusion_reason[missing_onset] <- "Flare candidate has no usable onset date"
  data$timing_exclusion_reason[before_start] <- "Flare onset precedes treatment start"
  data$timing_eligible <- is.na(data$timing_exclusion_reason)
  exclusions <- data[!data$timing_eligible,
    c("course_id", "patient_cluster_id", "endpoint", "analysis_flare", "onset_date", "onset_day", "timing_exclusion_reason"), drop = FALSE]
  retained <- data[data$timing_eligible, , drop = FALSE]
  retained$onset_after_observation <- retained$analysis_flare & retained$onset_day > retained$followup_days
  retained$endpoint_on_onset_day <- retained$analysis_flare & retained$status == 1L & retained$onset_day == retained$followup_days
  retained$onset_at_observation_boundary <- retained$analysis_flare & retained$onset_day == retained$followup_days
  list(data = retained, exclusions = exclusions)
}

edc_fit_exposure_cox <- function(data, exposure_column, counting_process = FALSE) {
  exposure <- data[[exposure_column]]
  event <- if (counting_process) data$event else data$status
  exposed_events <- sum(event == 1L & exposure == 1L)
  unexposed_events <- sum(event == 1L & exposure == 0L)
  rows <- data.frame(
    n_courses = length(unique(data$course_id)), n_patient_clusters = length(unique(data$patient_cluster_id)),
    exposed_courses = length(unique(data$course_id[exposure == 1L])),
    unexposed_courses = length(unique(data$course_id)) - length(unique(data$course_id[exposure == 1L])),
    courses_with_unexposed_time = length(unique(data$course_id[exposure == 0L])),
    events = sum(event == 1L), exposed_events = exposed_events, unexposed_events = unexposed_events,
    estimate = NA_real_, conf_low = NA_real_, conf_high = NA_real_, p_value = NA_real_,
    model_status = "Not estimable", diagnostic = NA_character_, sparse_note = NA_character_,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  if (exposed_events < 5L) {
    rows$sparse_note <- paste0("Only ", exposed_events, " endpoint event(s) in exposed time/group; estimate is sparse and exploratory")
  }
  reason <- if (nrow(data) == 0L) {
    "No eligible courses"
  } else if (length(unique(exposure)) < 2L) {
    "No exposure variation"
  } else if (length(unique(data$patient_cluster_id)) < 2L) {
    "Fewer than two independent patient clusters"
  } else if (exposed_events == 0L || unexposed_events == 0L) {
    "No endpoint events in one exposure state/group; ordinary Cox estimate is not reported"
  } else NA_character_
  if (!is.na(reason)) {
    rows$diagnostic <- reason
    return(list(table = rows, fit = NULL, warnings = character()))
  }
  rhs <- exposure_column
  lhs <- if (counting_process) "survival::Surv(tstart, tstop, event)" else "survival::Surv(followup_after_landmark_days, status)"
  model_formula <- stats::as.formula(paste(lhs, "~", rhs))
  warnings <- character()
  failure <- NULL
  fit <- tryCatch(
    withCallingHandlers(
      survival::coxph(model_formula, data = data, cluster = patient_cluster_id,
                      ties = "efron", robust = TRUE, x = TRUE, model = TRUE),
      warning = function(w) {
        warnings <<- c(warnings, conditionMessage(w))
        invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
      }
    ),
    error = function(e) { failure <<- conditionMessage(e); NULL }
  )
  bad_warning <- any(grepl("converg|infinite|singular|iteration|ran out", warnings, ignore.case = TRUE))
  if (is.null(fit) || bad_warning) {
    rows$diagnostic <- paste(c(failure, warnings), collapse = "; ")
    return(list(table = rows, fit = NULL, warnings = unique(c(failure, warnings))))
  }
  log_hr <- unname(stats::coef(fit)[1L])
  variance <- unname(stats::vcov(fit)[1L, 1L])
  se <- if (is.finite(variance) && variance > 0) sqrt(variance) else NA_real_
  estimate <- exp(log_hr)
  ci <- exp(log_hr + c(-1, 1) * stats::qnorm(0.975) * se)
  if (any(!is.finite(c(log_hr, variance, se, estimate, ci))) || variance <= 0) {
    rows$diagnostic <- "Nonfinite coefficient/confidence interval or nonpositive robust variance"
    return(list(table = rows, fit = NULL, warnings = unique(warnings)))
  }
  rows$estimate <- estimate
  rows$conf_low <- ci[1L]
  rows$conf_high <- ci[2L]
  rows$p_value <- 2 * stats::pnorm(-abs(log_hr / se))
  rows$model_status <- "Estimated (exploratory)"
  rows$diagnostic <- if (length(warnings)) paste(unique(warnings), collapse = "; ") else "Exposure-only Cox; Efron ties; patient-cluster robust standard errors"
  list(table = rows, fit = fit, warnings = unique(warnings))
}

edc_time_dependent_cox <- function(data, endpoint = c("PFS", "OS"),
                                   pfs_exclude_course_ids = character(), onset_overrides = NULL) {
  endpoint <- match.arg(endpoint)
  endpoint_result <- edc_build_endpoint(data, endpoint, pfs_exclude_course_ids, onset_overrides)
  timing <- edc_prepare_survival_timing(endpoint_result$data)
  eligible <- timing$data
  if (nrow(eligible)) {
    eligible$event <- eligible$status
    intervals <- survival::tmerge(data1 = eligible, data2 = eligible, id = course_id,
      tstop = followup_days, event = event(followup_days, status))
    updates <- eligible[eligible$analysis_flare, c("course_id", "onset_day"), drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(updates)) {
      intervals <- survival::tmerge(intervals, updates, id = course_id, flare_td = tdc(onset_day))
    } else intervals$flare_td <- 0L
    # tmerge uses (tstart, tstop]. An event at the onset boundary remains in
    # the preceding interval. No unobserved time-of-day or epsilon is added.
    tmerge_counts <- attr(intervals, "tcount")
    intervals <- as.data.frame(intervals)
    intervals$flare_td <- as.integer(intervals$flare_td)
  } else {
    intervals <- eligible
    intervals$tstart <- numeric()
    intervals$tstop <- numeric()
    intervals$event <- integer()
    intervals$flare_td <- integer()
    tmerge_counts <- NULL
  }
  fit <- edc_fit_exposure_cox(intervals, "flare_td", counting_process = TRUE)
  fit$table$endpoint <- endpoint
  fit$table$analysis_type <- "Time-dependent Cox"
  fit$table$landmark_day <- NA_real_
  fit$table$exposed_person_days <- sum((intervals$tstop - intervals$tstart)[intervals$flare_td == 1L])
  fit$table$unexposed_person_days <- sum((intervals$tstop - intervals$tstart)[intervals$flare_td == 0L])
  list(table = fit$table, intervals = intervals, fit = fit$fit, warnings = fit$warnings,
       endpoint_data = endpoint_result$data, endpoint_exclusions = endpoint_result$exclusions,
       endpoint_audit = endpoint_result$audit, endpoint_notes = endpoint_result$notes,
       timing_exclusions = timing$exclusions, timing_data = eligible, tmerge_counts = tmerge_counts)
}

edc_landmark_analysis <- function(data, endpoint = c("PFS", "OS"), landmark_days = c(30, 60),
                                  pfs_exclude_course_ids = character(), onset_overrides = NULL) {
  endpoint <- match.arg(endpoint)
  if (!length(landmark_days) || any(!is.finite(landmark_days) | landmark_days < 0) || anyDuplicated(landmark_days)) {
    stop("landmark_days must be unique, nonnegative finite days.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  endpoint_result <- edc_build_endpoint(data, endpoint, pfs_exclude_course_ids, onset_overrides)
  timing <- edc_prepare_survival_timing(endpoint_result$data)
  results <- lapply(landmark_days, function(day) {
    current <- timing$data
    current$landmark_day <- rep(day, nrow(current))
    current$landmark_exclusion_reason <- rep(NA_character_, nrow(current))
    event_before <- current$status == 1L & current$followup_days <= day
    inadequate <- current$followup_days <= day & !event_before
    current$landmark_exclusion_reason[event_before] <- "Endpoint at or before landmark"
    current$landmark_exclusion_reason[inadequate] <- "Follow-up does not extend beyond landmark"
    excluded <- current[!is.na(current$landmark_exclusion_reason),
      c("course_id", "patient_cluster_id", "endpoint", "landmark_day", "status", "followup_days", "landmark_exclusion_reason"), drop = FALSE]
    current <- current[is.na(current$landmark_exclusion_reason), , drop = FALSE]
    current$flare_by_landmark <- as.integer(current$analysis_flare & current$onset_day <= day)
    current$followup_after_landmark_days <- current$followup_days - day
    current$time_after_landmark_months <- current$followup_after_landmark_days / 30.4375
    fit <- edc_fit_exposure_cox(current, "flare_by_landmark")
    fit$table$endpoint <- endpoint
    fit$table$analysis_type <- "Landmark Cox"
    fit$table$landmark_day <- day
    list(table = fit$table, data = current, exclusions = excluded, fit = fit$fit, warnings = fit$warnings)
  })
  names(results) <- paste0("day", landmark_days)
  list(table = dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(results, `[[`, "table")),
       data = dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(results, `[[`, "data")),
       exclusions = dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(results, `[[`, "exclusions")),
       results = results, endpoint_exclusions = endpoint_result$exclusions,
       timing_exclusions = timing$exclusions)
}

edc_landmark_km_plot <- function(landmark_data, endpoint = NULL, landmark_day = NULL,
                                title = NULL, show_confidence = FALSE) {
  required <- c("endpoint", "landmark_day", "time_after_landmark_months", "status", "flare_by_landmark")
  if (!all(required %in% names(landmark_data))) stop("Pass landmark_data returned by edc_landmark_analysis or edc_run_survival_analyses.", call. = FALSE)
  data <- landmark_data
  if (!is.null(endpoint)) data <- data[data$endpoint == endpoint, , drop = FALSE]
  if (!is.null(landmark_day)) data <- data[data$landmark_day == landmark_day, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(data) && (length(unique(data$endpoint)) != 1L || length(unique(data$landmark_day)) != 1L)) {
    stop("Select exactly one endpoint and landmark_day for a Kaplan-Meier plot.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  if (nrow(data) == 0L) {
    return(ggplot2::ggplot() + ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0, label = "No eligible landmark follow-up") +
      ggplot2::theme_void() + ggplot2::labs(title = title))
  }
  endpoint <- data$endpoint[1L]
  day <- data$landmark_day[1L]
  labels <- c(paste0("No flare by day ", day), paste0("Flare by day ", day))
  data$landmark_group <- factor(data$flare_by_landmark, levels = c(0, 1), labels = labels)
  curves <- lapply(levels(droplevels(data$landmark_group)), function(group) {
    current <- data[data$landmark_group == group, , drop = FALSE]
    fit <- survival::survfit(survival::Surv(time_after_landmark_months, status) ~ 1, data = current,
      cluster = patient_cluster_id, robust = TRUE)
    data.frame(time = c(0, fit$time), survival = c(1, fit$surv),
               lower = c(1, fit$lower), upper = c(1, fit$upper),
               group = paste0(group, " (n=", nrow(current), ")"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  })
  curve <- dplyr::bind_rows(curves)
  palette <- stats::setNames(c("#1b4965", "#b23a48")[match(levels(droplevels(data$landmark_group)), labels)], unique(curve$group))
  plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(curve, ggplot2::aes(time, survival, color = group))
  if (show_confidence) {
    # Duplicate each event boundary to shade a right-continuous step band,
    # rather than interpolating uncertainty between observed event times.
    band <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(split(curve, curve$group), function(z) {
      n <- nrow(z)
      idx <- rep(seq_len(n), each = 2L)[seq_len(2L*n-1L)]
      stepped <- z[idx, , drop = FALSE]
      stepped$time <- c(z$time[1L], rep(z$time[-1L], each = 2L))
      stepped
    }))
    plot <- plot + ggplot2::geom_ribbon(data = band,
      ggplot2::aes(x = time, ymin = lower, ymax = upper, fill = group, group = group),
      inherit.aes = FALSE, color = NA, alpha = 0.12, show.legend = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE) +
      ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = palette)
  }
  plot <- plot +
    ggplot2::geom_step(linewidth = 0.8) +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = palette) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
    ggplot2::labs(title = if (is.null(title)) paste0(endpoint, " after the day-", day, " landmark") else title,
                  x = paste0("Months after day ", day), y = paste0(endpoint, " probability"), color = NULL,
                  caption = "Exploratory fixed-landmark comparison; later flares remain in the no-flare-by-landmark group.") +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 12) + ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  if (show_confidence) {
    plot <- plot + ggplot2::geom_step(ggplot2::aes(y = lower), linewidth = 0.35, linetype = "dotted", show.legend = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE) +
      ggplot2::geom_step(ggplot2::aes(y = upper), linewidth = 0.35, linetype = "dotted", show.legend = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  plot
}

edc_run_survival_analyses <- function(data, pfs_exclude_course_ids = character(),
                                      landmark_days = c(30, 60), onset_overrides = NULL,
                                      scenario = "Primary") {
  data <- edc_apply_onset_overrides(data, onset_overrides)
  # The override is applied once, retaining its provenance in every returned row.
  td <- lapply(c("PFS", "OS"), function(endpoint) edc_time_dependent_cox(data, endpoint, pfs_exclude_course_ids))
  lm <- lapply(c("PFS", "OS"), function(endpoint) edc_landmark_analysis(data, endpoint, landmark_days, pfs_exclude_course_ids))
  names(td) <- names(lm) <- c("PFS", "OS")
  combine <- function(results, field) {
    out <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(results, `[[`, field))
    out$scenario <- rep(scenario, nrow(out))
    out
  }
  warning_rows <- list()
  for (endpoint in names(td)) {
    if (length(td[[endpoint]]$warnings)) warning_rows[[length(warning_rows) + 1L]] <-
      data.frame(endpoint = endpoint, analysis_type = "Time-dependent Cox", landmark_day = NA_real_, warning = td[[endpoint]]$warnings)
    for (result in lm[[endpoint]]$results) if (length(result$warnings)) warning_rows[[length(warning_rows) + 1L]] <-
      data.frame(endpoint = endpoint, analysis_type = "Landmark Cox", landmark_day = result$table$landmark_day, warning = result$warnings)
  }
  warning_table <- if (length(warning_rows)) dplyr::bind_rows(warning_rows) else
    data.frame(endpoint = character(), analysis_type = character(), landmark_day = numeric(), warning = character())
  warning_table$scenario <- rep(scenario, nrow(warning_table))
  list(
    time_dependent_table = combine(td, "table"), landmark_table = combine(lm, "table"),
    intervals = combine(td, "intervals"), endpoint_data = combine(td, "endpoint_data"),
    endpoint_audit = combine(td, "endpoint_audit"), endpoint_exclusions = combine(td, "endpoint_exclusions"),
    endpoint_notes = combine(td, "endpoint_notes"), timing_exclusions = combine(td, "timing_exclusions"),
    timing_data = combine(td, "timing_data"), landmark_data = combine(lm, "data"),
    landmark_exclusions = combine(lm, "exclusions"), warnings = warning_table,
    fits = list(time_dependent = lapply(td, `[[`, "fit"),
                landmark = lapply(lm, function(x) lapply(x$results, `[[`, "fit"))),
    details = list(time_dependent = td, landmark = lm)
  )
}
reconciliation_functions.R
# Canonical fieldwise reconciliation. Controlled inputs carry all case-specific
# corrections; this module contains no case identities or clinical narratives.
tf_supported_products <- c("teclistamab","talquetamab","elranatamab","linvoseltamab")

tf_read_controlled_csv <- function(path) {
  d <- utils::read.csv(path,check.names=FALSE,stringsAsFactors=FALSE,na.strings="")
  dates <- intersect(c("start_date","full_dose_date","pd_date","death_date","last_contact_date",
    "step_up_day1","flare_onset_date","flare_peak_date","last_flare_assessment","flare_resolution_date",
    "last_bsab_dose_before_onset","flare_admission_date","bsab_resume_date","local_outcome_date",
    "first_postflare_response_date","subsequent_response_date","alternative_assessment_date",
    "onset_lower_date","onset_upper_date",paste0("infection_date_",1:7)),names(d))
  for(field in dates) d[[field]] <- edc_survival_date(d[[field]],field)
  d
}

tf_source_state <- function(x) {
  v <- as.character(x)
  ifelse(is.na(v)|!nzchar(trimws(v)),"Blank",ifelse(tolower(trimws(v)) %in%
    c("unknown","ne","ne/unknown","not reassessed","not applicable"),v,"Recorded"))
}

tf_value_text <- function(x) {
  out <- as.character(x); out[is.na(out)] <- ""; out
}

tf_best_index_response <- function(first,later,first_on_index=TRUE,later_on_index=TRUE) {
  levels <- tf_response_levels[1:7]
  candidates <- c(if(isTRUE(first_on_index))as.character(first),if(isTRUE(later_on_index))as.character(later))
  supported <- candidates[candidates %in% levels]
  if(!length(supported)) return("NE/Unknown")
  levels[min(match(supported,levels))]
}

tf_recalculate_infection_windows <- function(x) {
  if(!all(paste0("infection_date_",1:7) %in% names(x)))return(x)
  for(i in seq_len(nrow(x))) {
    dates <- as.Date(vapply(1:7,function(k)as.numeric(x[[paste0("infection_date_",k)]][i]),numeric(1)),origin="1970-01-01")
    severe <- vapply(1:7,function(k)isTRUE(x[[paste0("infection_severe_",k)]][i]),logical(1))
    known <- vapply(1:7,function(k)isTRUE(x[[paste0("infection_severity_known_",k)]][i]),logical(1))
    within <- !is.na(dates)&!is.na(x$start_date[i])&dates>=x$start_date[i]&dates<=x$start_date[i]+30
    flag<-x$infection_flag[i];count<-x$infection_count[i]
    documented<-any(!is.na(dates))||isTRUE(flag)||(!is.na(count)&&count>0)
    explicit_no<-(identical(flag,FALSE)||(!is.na(count)&&count==0))&&!documented
    complete<-explicit_no||(!is.na(count)&&count>=0&&count<=7&&sum(!is.na(dates))==count)
    x$infection_30d[i]<-if(any(within))TRUE else if(explicit_no||(complete&&!is.na(x$start_date[i])))FALSE else NA
    x$severe_infection_30d[i]<-if(any(within&severe))TRUE else if(explicit_no||(complete&&!is.na(x$start_date[i])&&all(known[within])))FALSE else NA
  }
  x
}

tf_reconcile <- function(master,cases,corrections=NULL,master_sources=NULL,trace=TRUE) {
  if(anyDuplicated(master$course_id)||anyDuplicated(cases$course_id))stop("Course identities must be unique")
  master$eligibility_verified<-TRUE
  unmatched<-which(!cases$course_id %in% master$course_id)
  if(length(unmatched))for(i in unmatched) {
    row<-master[1,,drop=FALSE]
    for(field in names(row))row[[field]][1]<-NA
    row$course_id<-cases$course_id[i]
    row$patient_cluster_id<-paste0("unlinked_course:",cases$course_id[i])
    row$site<-cases$site[i];row$site_key<-cases$site_key[i]
    row$product<-cases$bsab_product[i];row$product_key<-tolower(cases$bsab_product[i])
    row$original_response<-row$analysis_response<-"NE/Unknown"
    row$pfs_excluded<-FALSE
    row$eligibility_verified<-FALSE
    master<-rbind(master,row)
  }
  original <- master
  x <- master
  x$edc_received <- x$course_id %in% cases$course_id
  x$investigator_confidence <- NA_character_
  x$onset_date <- as.Date(NA_character_)
  x$pfs_excluded <- as.logical(x$pfs_excluded)
  if(anyNA(x$pfs_excluded))x$pfs_excluded[is.na(x$pfs_excluded)]<-FALSE
  audit<-list();provenance<-list()
  add <- function(ids,field,old,value,source,source_field,reason,reference=NULL) {
    if(!trace)return(invisible(NULL))
    supporting<-if(source=="Master")master_sources else cases
    pos<-if(!is.null(supporting))match(ids,supporting$course_id)else rep(NA_integer_,length(ids))
    get_ref<-function(name)if(!is.null(supporting)&&name %in% names(supporting))
      tf_value_text(supporting[[name]][pos])else rep("",length(ids))
    rows<-data.frame(course_id=ids,field=field,source=source,source_field=source_field,
      source_value=tf_value_text(value),source_state=tf_source_state(value),
      original_master_value=tf_value_text(old),canonical_value=tf_value_text(value),
      changed=tf_value_text(old)!=tf_value_text(value),reason=reason,
      source_file=get_ref("source_file"),source_sheet=get_ref("source_sheet"),
      source_row=get_ref("source_row"),clarification_pointer=get_ref("clarification_pointer"),controlled_rule_pointer="",
      supporting_references="",stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
    if(source=="EDC"&&field %in% c("analysis_response","case.first_response_on_index","case.subsequent_response_on_index"))
      rows$controlled_rule_pointer<-get_ref("response_attribution_pointer")
    if(source=="EDC"&&startsWith(field,"case.")&&!is.null(corrections)&&nrow(corrections)) {
      rr<-corrections[corrections$field==sub("^case\\.","",field),,drop=FALSE]
      rp<-match(rows$course_id,rr$course_id)
      selected<-!is.na(rp)
      for(name in intersect(c("source_file","source_sheet","source_row","clarification_pointer","controlled_rule_pointer"),names(rr)))
        rows[[name]][selected]<-tf_value_text(rr[[name]][rp[selected]])
    }
    if(!is.null(reference))for(name in intersect(c("source_file","source_sheet","source_row",
      "clarification_pointer","controlled_rule_pointer","supporting_references"),names(reference)))
      rows[[name]]<-tf_value_text(reference[[name]])
    invalidated<-is.na(value)&grepl("unavailable|contradict|invalid|unresolved",reason,ignore.case=TRUE)
    rows$source_state[invalidated]<-"Unavailable after source reconciliation"
    provenance[[length(provenance)+1L]]<<-rows
    audit[[length(audit)+1L]]<<-rows[rows$changed,,drop=FALSE]
  }
  master_fields<-setdiff(names(x),c("course_id","patient_cluster_id","site_key","edc_received"))
  for(field in master_fields) add(x$course_id,field,x[[field]],x[[field]],"Master",field,"Master supplies a separate concept that site collection does not reassess")
  case_corrections<-integer()
  if(!is.null(corrections)&&nrow(corrections))for(i in seq_len(nrow(corrections))) {
    r<-corrections[i,,drop=FALSE];field<-as.character(r$field)
    if(!field %in% names(cases)||field %in% c("course_id","case_id","source_file","source_sheet","source_row"))next
    k<-match(r$course_id,cases$course_id)
    if(is.na(k))stop("Site case clarification has no authoritative return")
    old<-cases[[field]][k]
    value<-if(r$action=="invalidate")NA else as.character(r$value)
    if(inherits(old,"Date"))value<-as.Date(value)else if(is.logical(old))value<-as.logical(value)else if(is.numeric(old))value<-as.numeric(value)
    cases[[field]][k]<-value
    add(r$course_id,paste0("case.",field),old,value,"Verified site clarification",field,as.character(r$reason),r)
    case_corrections<-c(case_corrections,i)
  }
  for(i in seq_len(nrow(cases))) {
    j<-match(cases$course_id[i],x$course_id)
    confidence<-as.character(cases$investigator_confidence[i])
    flare<-if(confidence %in% c("Definite","Probable","Possible"))TRUE else if(!is.na(confidence)&&confidence=="Not tumor flare")FALSE else NA
    mappings<-list(start_date=cases$step_up_day1[i],product=as.character(cases$bsab_product[i]),
      analysis_flare=flare,onset_date=cases$flare_onset_date[i],investigator_confidence=confidence,
      analysis_response=tf_best_index_response(cases$first_postflare_response[i],cases$subsequent_response[i],
        cases$first_response_on_index[i],cases$subsequent_response_on_index[i]))
    source_fields<-c(start_date="step_up_day1",product="bsab_product",analysis_flare="investigator_confidence",
      onset_date="flare_onset_date",investigator_confidence="investigator_confidence",
      analysis_response="first_postflare_response; subsequent_response; first_response_on_index; subsequent_response_on_index")
    for(field in names(mappings)) {
      old<-x[[field]][j];x[[field]][j]<-mappings[[field]]
      add(x$course_id[j],field,old,mappings[[field]],"EDC",source_fields[[field]],
        "Authoritative returned value, including explicit uncertainty or blank; no master backfill")
    }
    for(field in setdiff(names(cases),c("course_id","case_id","source_file","source_sheet","source_row"))) {
      add(x$course_id[j],paste0("case.",field),NA_character_,cases[[field]][i],"EDC",field,"Scoped index-event field stays separate from whole-course measures")
    }
    # A positive scoped event establishes occurrence somewhere in the course.
    # A negative scoped event cannot negate other events elsewhere in the course.
    implications<-c(overlap_crs="crs_1",overlap_icans="icans_1",flare_hospitalization="any_admission",
      management_steroids="steroids",overlap_infection="any_infection")
    for(field in names(implications)) if(isTRUE(cases[[field]][i]=="Yes")) {
      target<-implications[[field]];old<-x[[target]][j];x[[target]][j]<-TRUE
      add(x$course_id[j],target,old,TRUE,"EDC",field,"Positive index event establishes corresponding whole-course occurrence")
    }
    if(isTRUE(cases$overlap_crs[i]=="Yes")&&isTRUE(x$crs_grade[j]==0)) {
      add(x$course_id[j],"crs_grade",x$crs_grade[j],NA_real_,"EDC","overlap_crs","Occurrence confirmed; maximum grade is not supplied by this field")
      x$crs_grade[j]<-NA_real_
      for(target in c("crs_2","crs_3")) {
        add(x$course_id[j],target,x[[target]][j],NA,"EDC","overlap_crs","Occurrence confirmed; higher severity unavailable")
        x[[target]][j]<-NA
      }
    }
    if(isTRUE(cases$overlap_icans[i]=="Yes")&&isTRUE(x$icans_grade[j]==0)) {
      add(x$course_id[j],"icans_grade",x$icans_grade[j],NA_real_,"EDC","overlap_icans","Occurrence confirmed; maximum grade is not supplied by this field")
      x$icans_grade[j]<-NA_real_
      for(target in c("icans_2","icans_3")) {
        add(x$course_id[j],target,x[[target]][j],NA,"EDC","overlap_icans","Occurrence confirmed; higher severity unavailable")
        x[[target]][j]<-NA
      }
    }
    if(isTRUE(cases$flare_hospitalization[i]=="Yes")&&isTRUE(x$hospital_days[j]==0)) {
      add(x$course_id[j],"hospital_days",x$hospital_days[j],NA_real_,"EDC","flare_hospitalization","Admission confirmed; whole-course total days unavailable rather than replaced by flare-only days")
      x$hospital_days[j]<-NA_real_
    }
    if(isTRUE(cases$overlap_infection[i]=="Yes")) {
      add(x$course_id[j],"infection_flag",x$infection_flag[j],TRUE,"EDC","overlap_infection","Infection occurrence confirmed; scoped timing and severity do not establish all-course counts")
      x$infection_flag[j]<-TRUE
      if(isTRUE(x$infection_count[j]==0)) {
        add(x$course_id[j],"infection_count",x$infection_count[j],NA_real_,"EDC","overlap_infection","Contradicted zero count becomes unavailable")
        x$infection_count[j]<-NA_real_
      }
      if(isTRUE(x$severe_infection[j]==FALSE)) {
        add(x$course_id[j],"severe_infection",x$severe_infection[j],NA,"EDC","overlap_infection","Severity unavailable for the newly confirmed infection")
        x$severe_infection[j]<-NA
      }
    }
    # The early true-PD field plus an explicitly dated PD assessment in that
    # window establishes a true-progression date; apparent PD alone does not.
    date<-cases$first_postflare_response_date[i]
    onset<-cases$flare_onset_date[i]
    if(isTRUE(cases$true_pd_within_14d[i]=="Yes")&&isTRUE(cases$first_postflare_response[i]=="PD")&&
       !is.na(date)&&!is.na(onset)&&date>=onset&&date<=onset+14) {
      old<-x$pd_date[j];x$pd_date[j]<-date
      add(x$course_id[j],"pd_date",old,date,"EDC","true_pd_within_14d; first_postflare_response_date",
        "Site confirms true early progression and supplies the corresponding assessment date")
    }
  }
  if(!is.null(corrections)&&nrow(corrections))for(i in setdiff(seq_len(nrow(corrections)),case_corrections)) {
    r<-corrections[i,,drop=FALSE];j<-match(r$course_id,x$course_id)
    if(is.na(j))stop("Correction refers to an unknown normalized course")
    field<-as.character(r$field)
    in_cases<-field %in% names(cases)&&!field %in% names(x)
    if(in_cases) {
      k<-match(r$course_id,cases$course_id)
      if(is.na(k))stop("Case correction has no authoritative returned case")
      old<-cases[[field]][k]
    } else {
      if(!field %in% names(x))stop("Unknown correction field: ",field)
      old<-x[[field]][j]
    }
    value<-if(r$action=="invalidate")NA else as.character(r$value)
    if(inherits(old,"Date"))value<-as.Date(value) else if(is.logical(old))value<-as.logical(value) else if(is.numeric(old))value<-as.numeric(value)
    if(in_cases)cases[[field]][k]<-value else x[[field]][j]<-value
    add(x$course_id[j],if(in_cases)paste0("case.",field)else field,old,value,"Verified site clarification",field,as.character(r$reason),r)
  }
  derive<-function(field,value,inputs,reason) {
    if(!trace){x[[field]]<<-value;return(invisible(NULL))}
    old<-if(field %in% names(x))x[[field]]else rep(NA_character_,nrow(x))
    previous<-dplyr::bind_rows(provenance)
    previous<-previous[!duplicated(paste(previous$course_id,previous$field),fromLast=TRUE),,drop=FALSE]
    previous<-previous[previous$field %in% inputs,,drop=FALSE]
    by_course<-split(previous,previous$course_id)
    references<-vapply(x$course_id,function(id) {
      r<-by_course[[id]]
      if(is.null(r))return("")
      text<-paste0(r$field,": ",r$source_file," [",r$source_sheet,", row ",r$source_row,"]",
        ifelse(nzchar(r$clarification_pointer),paste0("; ",r$clarification_pointer),""),
        ifelse(nzchar(r$controlled_rule_pointer),paste0("; ",r$controlled_rule_pointer),""))
      paste(unique(text),collapse=" | ")
    },character(1))
    x[[field]]<<-value
    add(x$course_id,field,old,value,"Derived from canonical source fields",paste(inputs,collapse="; "),reason,
      list(source_file="",source_sheet="",source_row="",supporting_references=references))
  }
  derive("product_key",tolower(as.character(x$product)),"product","Normalized authoritative course product")
  bcma<-x$product_key %in% setdiff(tf_supported_products,"talquetamab")
  rank_group<-ifelse(bcma,x$patient_cluster_id,paste0("nonbcma:",x$course_id))
  idx<-order(rank_group,is.na(x$start_date),x$start_date,is.na(x$full_dose_date),x$full_dose_date,x$course_id)
  first<-rep(TRUE,nrow(x));first[idx]<-!duplicated(rank_group[idx])
  derive("keep_first_bcma",first,c("product","start_date","full_dose_date"),
    "First BCMA course is ordered within the supplied patient cluster by authoritative step-up date, then full-dose date and course ID; GPRC5D courses remain eligible")
  infection<-tf_recalculate_infection_windows(x)
  infection_inputs<-c("start_date","infection_flag","infection_count",paste0("infection_date_",1:7),
    paste0("infection_severe_",1:7),paste0("infection_severity_known_",1:7))
  for(field in c("any_infection","severe_infection"))derive(field,x[[field]],
    c(infection_inputs,paste0("case.overlap_infection")),
    "Final course-level occurrence/severity after scoped positive-event reconciliation; unknown new-event severity stays unavailable")
  for(field in c("infection_30d","severe_infection_30d"))derive(field,infection[[field]],infection_inputs,
    "Recomputed after source precedence; positive dated occurrence establishes the window, and incomplete contradicted counts never establish a negative window")
  cases$analysis_flare<-x$analysis_flare[match(cases$course_id,x$course_id)]
  cases$best_index_response<-x$analysis_response[match(cases$course_id,x$course_id)]
  cases$bridging_any<-x$bridging_any[match(cases$course_id,x$course_id)]
  cases$keep_first_bcma<-x$keep_first_bcma[match(cases$course_id,x$course_id)]
  membership<-x$product_key %in% tf_supported_products&x$keep_first_bcma&!x$bridging_any&x$eligibility_verified
  membership[is.na(membership)]<-FALSE
  derive("comparative_eligible",membership,c("product_key","keep_first_bcma","bridging_any","eligibility_verified"),
    "Supported product, first BCMA/all GPRC5D, nonbridging and verified linkage eligibility")
  eligible<-x[membership,,drop=FALSE]
  primary<-eligible[!is.na(eligible$analysis_flare),,drop=FALSE]
  strict<-primary[is.na(primary$investigator_confidence)|primary$investigator_confidence!="Possible",,drop=FALSE]
  cases$comparative_included<-cases$course_id %in% primary$course_id
  records<-if(trace)dplyr::bind_rows(provenance)else data.frame(course_id=character(),field=character(),changed=logical())
  records$record_order<-seq_len(nrow(records))
  records$is_final_record<-!duplicated(paste(records$course_id,records$field),fromLast=TRUE)
  changes<-records[records$changed,,drop=FALSE]
  list(master=x,cases=cases,eligible=eligible,cohorts=list(primary=primary,strict=strict),
    provenance=records,register=changes,original=original)
}
model_functions.R
# Generic Firth/bootstrap and survival models on normalized controlled inputs.
tf_ash_covariates <- c("age10","ecog2","female","prior_lines","hrca","true_emd")
tf_ash_specs <- function() {
  data.frame(field=c(tf_ash_covariates,"hgb","albumin","log2_ldh","log2_ferritin","log2_crp"),
    label=c("Age, per 10 years","ECOG 2–5 vs 0–1","Female vs male","Prior treatment lines, per line",
      "At least one HRCA vs none","True EMD vs none/paraskeletal only","Hemoglobin, per g/dL",
      "Albumin, per g/dL","LDH, per doubling","Ferritin, per doubling","CRP, per doubling"),
    family=c(rep("Baseline",6),rep("Laboratory",5)),
    primary_question=c(rep(FALSE,5),TRUE,rep(FALSE,5)),stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
}

tf_ash_model_data <- function(cohort) {
  b <- tf_baseline_data(cohort); o <- tf_outcome_data(cohort)
  ecog <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(b$ecog))
  d <- data.frame(course_id=cohort$course_id,patient_cluster_id=cohort$patient_cluster_id,
    site_key=cohort$site_key,flare=as.integer(cohort$analysis_flare),
    age10=ifelse(is.finite(b$age)&b$age>0,b$age/10,NA_real_),
    ecog2=ifelse(ecog %in% 0:5,as.integer(ecog>=2),NA_integer_),
    female=ifelse(b$sex=="Female",1L,ifelse(b$sex=="Male",0L,NA_integer_)),
    prior_lines=ifelse(is.finite(b$prior_lots)&b$prior_lots>=0,b$prior_lots,NA_real_),
    hrca=as.integer(b$hrca),true_emd=ifelse(b$emd=="True EMD with/without paraskeletal",1L,
      ifelse(b$emd %in% c("None","Paraskeletal only"),0L,NA_integer_)),
    hgb=b$hgb,albumin=b$albumin,stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  for(field in c("ldh","ferritin","crp")) {
    z<-b[[field]]; d[[paste0("log2_",field)]]<-ifelse(is.finite(z)&z>0,log2(ifelse(z>0,z,NA_real_)),NA_real_)
  }
  known <- cohort$analysis_response %in% tf_response_levels[1:7]
  for(threshold in c("pr","vgpr","cr")) {
    levels <- switch(threshold,pr=tf_response_levels[1:4],vgpr=tf_response_levels[1:3],cr=tf_response_levels[1:2])
    d[[paste0("response_",threshold)]]<-ifelse(known,as.integer(cohort$analysis_response %in% levels),NA_integer_)
  }
  for(field in c("crs_1","icans_1","toci_treatment","toci_prophylaxis","any_admission","infection_30d","severe_infection_30d")) d[[field]]<-as.integer(o[[field]])
  d$hospital_days_admitted<-ifelse(!is.na(o$hospital_days)&o$hospital_days>0,o$hospital_days,NA_real_)
  if(anyDuplicated(d$course_id)) stop("ASH model input must have unique course IDs.")
  if(anyNA(d$patient_cluster_id)||any(!nzchar(d$patient_cluster_id))) stop("Documented cluster IDs are required.")
  d
}

tf_ash_missingness <- function(d,fields,scenario) {
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(fields,function(field) dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(c(0,1),function(group) {
    z<-d[d$flare==group,,drop=FALSE]
    data.frame(scenario=scenario,field=field,group=if(group)"Flare candidate" else "No included flare",
      total=nrow(z),evaluable=sum(is.finite(z[[field]])),unavailable=sum(!is.finite(z[[field]])))
  }))))
}

tf_ash_firth_fit <- function(d,response,predictors,term) {
  warnings<-character(); failure<-NULL
  if(!nrow(d)||length(unique(d[[response]]))<2L||length(unique(d[[term]]))<2L)
    return(list(coefficient=NA_real_,diagnostic="No outcome or predictor variation",converged=FALSE))
  formula<-stats::reformulate(predictors,response=response)
  fit<-tryCatch(withCallingHandlers(logistf::logistf(formula,data=d,pl=FALSE,
    control=logistf::logistf.control(maxit=200,lconv=1e-7,gconv=1e-7,xconv=1e-7)),
    warning=function(w){warnings<<-c(warnings,conditionMessage(w));invokeRestart("muffleWarning")}),
    error=function(e){failure<<-conditionMessage(e);NULL})
  ok<-!is.null(fit)&&all(is.finite(fit$coefficients))&&length(fit$conv)==3L&&
    all(is.finite(fit$conv))&&all(abs(fit$conv)<=1.1e-7)&&
    !any(grepl("converg|singular|infinite|maximum number",warnings,ignore.case=TRUE))
  coef<-if(ok)unname(fit$coefficients[term]) else NA_real_
  list(coefficient=coef,converged=ok&&is.finite(coef),
    diagnostic=if(ok)"Firth penalized likelihood converged" else paste(c(failure,warnings,"Convergence criteria not met"),collapse="; "))
}

tf_ash_cluster_indices <- function(cluster_ids) {
  blocks<-split(seq_along(cluster_ids),cluster_ids)
  unlist(blocks[sample.int(length(blocks),length(blocks),replace=TRUE)],use.names=FALSE)
}

tf_ash_bootstrap_inference <- function(coefficient,draws,B,minimum=ceiling(.9*B)) {
  valid<-draws[is.finite(draws)]; se<-if(length(valid)>1L)stats::sd(valid) else NA_real_
  ok<-length(valid)>=minimum&&is.finite(coefficient)&&is.finite(se)&&se>0
  ci<-if(ok)exp(coefficient+c(-1,1)*stats::qnorm(.975)*se) else c(NA_real_,NA_real_)
  if(any(!is.finite(ci)))ok<-FALSE
  list(successes=length(valid),se=if(ok)se else NA_real_,estimate=if(is.finite(coefficient))exp(coefficient) else NA_real_,
    conf_low=if(ok)ci[1] else NA_real_,conf_high=if(ok)ci[2] else NA_real_,
    p_value=if(ok)2*stats::pnorm(-abs(coefficient/se)) else NA_real_,inference_available=ok)
}

tf_ash_firth_cluster <- function(d,response,predictors,term,label,family,scenario,
    model_id,B=1000L,seed=20261106L,cache_dir=NULL,progress=TRUE) {
  fields<-unique(c(response,predictors)); use<-stats::complete.cases(d[fields])&
    apply(d[fields],1,function(x)all(is.finite(x)))
  z<-d[use,,drop=FALSE]
  row<-data.frame(model_id=model_id,scenario=scenario,family=family,label=label,response=response,
    term=term,adjustment=paste(setdiff(predictors,term),collapse="; "),total_courses=nrow(d),
    n_courses=nrow(z),n_patient_clusters=length(unique(z$patient_cluster_id)),
    candidates=sum(z$flare),events=sum(z[[response]]),candidate_events=sum(z[[response]][z$flare==1]),
    excluded_missing=nrow(d)-nrow(z),estimate=NA_real_,conf_low=NA_real_,conf_high=NA_real_,p_value=NA_real_,
    bootstrap_successes=0L,bootstrap_requested=B,bootstrap_seed=seed,bootstrap_se=NA_real_,
    model_status="Not estimable",diagnostic="",stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  # Cache is keyed to the exact coded analytic inputs, parameters and implementation.
  keyfile<-tempfile();on.exit(unlink(keyfile),add=TRUE)
  saveRDS(list(z=z[unique(c("course_id","patient_cluster_id","flare",fields))],response=response,
    predictors=predictors,term=term,B=B,seed=seed,
    implementation=lapply(list(tf_ash_firth_fit,tf_ash_cluster_indices,tf_ash_bootstrap_inference),function(f)deparse(body(f))),
    logistf_version=as.character(utils::packageVersion("logistf"))),keyfile)
  key<-unname(tools::md5sum(keyfile)); cache<-if(!is.null(cache_dir))file.path(cache_dir,paste0(model_id,"_",key,".rds")) else NULL
  if(!is.null(cache)&&file.exists(cache))return(readRDS(cache))
  point<-tf_ash_firth_fit(z,response,predictors,term);draws<-rep(NA_real_,B)
  failure_counts<-integer()
  if(point$converged&&length(unique(z$patient_cluster_id))>=2L) {
    set.seed(seed)
    for(k in seq_len(B)) {
      zz<-z[tf_ash_cluster_indices(z$patient_cluster_id),,drop=FALSE]
      fit<-tf_ash_firth_fit(zz,response,predictors,term)
      if(fit$converged)draws[k]<-fit$coefficient else {
        reason<-fit$diagnostic
        if(!reason %in% names(failure_counts))failure_counts[reason]<-0L
        failure_counts[reason]<-failure_counts[reason]+1L
      }
      if(progress&&k%%250L==0L)message(model_id,": ",k,"/",B," cluster resamples")
    }
  }
  inf<-tf_ash_bootstrap_inference(point$coefficient,draws,B)
  for(field in c("estimate","conf_low","conf_high","p_value"))row[[field]]<-inf[[field]]
  row$bootstrap_successes<-inf$successes;row$bootstrap_se<-inf$se
  row$model_status<-if(inf$inference_available)"Estimated (exploratory)" else if(point$converged)"Point estimate only; bootstrap inference suppressed" else "Not estimable"
  row$diagnostic<-paste(point$diagnostic,if(!inf$inference_available)paste0("; fewer than ",ceiling(.9*B)," converged resamples or invalid variance") else "; patient-cluster bootstrap Wald inference",sep="")
  diagnostics<-data.frame(model_id=model_id,scenario=scenario,family=family,requested=B,successful=inf$successes,
    seed=seed,minimum_successes=ceiling(.9*B),point_converged=point$converged,
    failure_summary=paste(names(failure_counts),failure_counts,sep=" [",collapse="; "),stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  membership<-data.frame(model_id=model_id,scenario=scenario,course_id=d$course_id,included=use,
    exclusion_reason=vapply(seq_len(nrow(d)),function(i)if(use[i])"" else paste(fields[!is.finite(as.numeric(d[i,fields]))],collapse="; "),character(1)))
  out<-list(table=row,diagnostics=diagnostics,membership=membership,draws=draws)
  if(!is.null(cache)){dir.create(cache_dir,recursive=TRUE,showWarnings=FALSE);saveRDS(out,cache)}
  out
}

tf_ash_fit_cox <- function(intervals,covariates,scenario,model_label,total_courses) {
  use<-if(length(covariates))stats::complete.cases(intervals[covariates]) else rep(TRUE,nrow(intervals))
  z<-intervals[use,,drop=FALSE]
  base<-edc_fit_exposure_cox(z,"flare_td",counting_process=TRUE)
  row<-base$table;row$scenario<-scenario;row$model<-model_label;row$total_model_eligible_courses<-total_courses
  row$excluded_missing<-total_courses-length(unique(z$course_id));row$adjustment<-paste(covariates,collapse="; ")
  row$ph_global_p<-NA_real_;row$ph_flare_p<-NA_real_
  if(!length(covariates))return(list(table=row,fit=base$fit))
  row[c("estimate","conf_low","conf_high","p_value")]<-NA_real_;row$model_status<-"Not estimable"
  if(!nrow(z)||row$exposed_events==0L||row$unexposed_events==0L)return(list(table=row,fit=NULL))
  warnings<-character();failure<-NULL
  formula<-stats::as.formula(paste("survival::Surv(tstart,tstop,event) ~ flare_td +",paste(covariates,collapse=" + ")))
  fit<-tryCatch(withCallingHandlers(survival::coxph(formula,data=z,cluster=patient_cluster_id,
    ties="efron",robust=TRUE,x=TRUE,model=TRUE),warning=function(w){warnings<<-c(warnings,conditionMessage(w));invokeRestart("muffleWarning")}),
    error=function(e){failure<<-conditionMessage(e);NULL})
  ok<-!is.null(fit)&&all(is.finite(stats::coef(fit)))&&!any(grepl("converg|infinite|singular|iteration",warnings,ignore.case=TRUE))
  if(ok) {
    beta<-unname(stats::coef(fit)["flare_td"]);se<-sqrt(stats::vcov(fit)["flare_td","flare_td"])
    ci<-exp(beta+c(-1,1)*stats::qnorm(.975)*se)
    ok<-all(is.finite(c(beta,se,ci)))&&se>0
    if(ok){row$estimate<-exp(beta);row$conf_low<-ci[1];row$conf_high<-ci[2];row$p_value<-2*stats::pnorm(-abs(beta/se));row$model_status<-"Estimated (exploratory)"}
    ph<-tryCatch(survival::cox.zph(fit),error=function(e)NULL)
    if(!is.null(ph)){row$ph_global_p<-ph$table["GLOBAL","p"];row$ph_flare_p<-ph$table["flare_td","p"]}
  }
  row$diagnostic<-if(ok)paste("Six baseline covariates; Efron ties; patient-cluster robust SE",paste(warnings,collapse="; "),sep="; ") else paste(c(failure,warnings,"Invalid adjusted fit"),collapse="; ")
  list(table=row,fit=if(ok)fit else NULL)
}

tf_survival_scenarios <- function(analysis,cohorts=NULL) {
  if(is.null(cohorts))cohorts<-analysis$cohorts
  historical<-analysis$cohorts$primary
  pos<-match(historical$course_id,analysis$original$course_id)
  for(field in c("pd_date","death_date","last_contact_date"))historical[[field]]<-analysis$original[[field]][pos]
  historical$pfs_excluded<-FALSE
  cohorts$original_master_endpoints<-historical
  rules<-analysis$survival_scenario_rules
  if(!is.null(rules)&&nrow(rules))for(scenario in unique(rules$scenario)) {
    d<-analysis$cohorts$primary
    rr<-rules[rules$scenario==scenario,,drop=FALSE]
    for(i in seq_len(nrow(rr))) {
      field<-rr$field[i];pos<-match(rr$course_id[i],d$course_id)
      if(is.na(pos)||!field %in% c("onset_date","pd_date","death_date","last_contact_date","pfs_excluded"))
        stop("Invalid controlled survival sensitivity rule")
      value<-if(rr$action[i]=="invalidate")NA else rr$value[i]
      if(inherits(d[[field]],"Date"))value<-as.Date(value)else if(is.logical(d[[field]]))value<-as.logical(value)
      d[[field]][pos]<-value
    }
    cohorts[[scenario]]<-d
  }
  cohorts
}

tf_ash_survival <- function(analysis,cohorts,model_data) {
  tables<-members<-landmarks<-list()
  cohorts<-tf_survival_scenarios(analysis,cohorts)
  model_data<-lapply(cohorts,tf_ash_model_data)
  for(scenario in names(cohorts))for(endpoint in c("PFS","OS")) {
    cohort<-cohorts[[scenario]];d<-model_data[[scenario]]
    exclude<-cohort$course_id[cohort$pfs_excluded]
    input<-cohort[c("course_id","patient_cluster_id","start_date","pd_date","death_date","last_contact_date","analysis_flare","onset_date")]
    run<-edc_time_dependent_cox(input,endpoint,exclude)
    intervals<-merge(run$intervals,d[c("course_id",tf_ash_covariates)],by="course_id",sort=FALSE)
    complete<-stats::complete.cases(d[tf_ash_covariates]);cc_ids<-d$course_id[complete]
    n<-length(unique(intervals$course_id))
    for(model in c("Unadjusted: all eligible","Unadjusted: adjusted subset","Adjusted: six baseline variables")) {
      z<-if(model=="Unadjusted: all eligible")intervals else intervals[intervals$course_id %in% cc_ids,,drop=FALSE]
      fit<-tf_ash_fit_cox(z,if(startsWith(model,"Adjusted"))tf_ash_covariates else character(),scenario,model,n)
      fit$table$endpoint<-endpoint
      fit$table$scenario_interpretation<-if(scenario=="original_master_endpoints")
        "Historical audit of superseded master values; not a valid clinical endpoint sensitivity or canonical inference"else
        "Exploratory clinical analysis using authoritative reconciled endpoints"
      tables[[length(tables)+1L]]<-fit$table
    }
    members[[length(members)+1L]]<-data.frame(scenario=scenario,endpoint=endpoint,course_id=d$course_id,
      endpoint_and_timing_eligible=d$course_id %in% intervals$course_id,
      complete_baseline_covariates=complete,
      adjusted_included=d$course_id %in% intervals$course_id&complete)
    lm<-edc_landmark_analysis(input,endpoint,pfs_exclude_course_ids=exclude)
    lm$table$scenario<-scenario
    lm$table$scenario_interpretation<-if(scenario=="original_master_endpoints")
      "Historical audit of superseded master values; not a valid clinical endpoint sensitivity or canonical inference"else
      "Exploratory clinical analysis using authoritative reconciled endpoints"
    landmarks[[length(landmarks)+1L]]<-lm$table
  }
  list(table=dplyr::bind_rows(tables),membership=dplyr::bind_rows(members),landmark_table=dplyr::bind_rows(landmarks))
}

tf_build_ash_extension <- function(analysis,output_dir,B=1000L,seed=20261106L,progress=TRUE) {
  if(!requireNamespace("logistf",quietly=TRUE))stop("The requested logistf package is unavailable in the project R library.")
  cohorts<-list(primary=analysis$cohorts$primary,strict=analysis$cohorts$strict,
    without_dominant_site=analysis$cohorts$primary[!analysis$cohorts$primary$site_key %in% analysis$excluded_site_keys,,drop=FALSE])
  data<-lapply(cohorts,tf_ash_model_data); specs<-tf_ash_specs()
  models<-list();miss<-list();clinical<-list();los<-list()
  cache_dir<-file.path(output_dir,"build","model_cache")
  add_model<-function(d,response,predictors,term,label,family,scenario,id) {
    models[[length(models)+1L]]<<-tf_ash_firth_cluster(d,response,predictors,term,label,family,scenario,id,
      B=B,seed=analysis$model_seeds$seed[match(id,analysis$model_seeds$model_id)],cache_dir=cache_dir,progress=progress)
  }
  for(scenario in names(cohorts)) {
    d<-data[[scenario]]
    miss[[length(miss)+1L]]<-tf_ash_missingness(d,specs$field,scenario)
    for(k in seq_len(nrow(specs))) {
      sp<-specs[k,];add_model(d,"flare",sp$field,sp$field,sp$label,sp$family,scenario,paste(scenario,sp$field,sep="_"))
    }
    for(threshold in c("pr","vgpr","cr")) {
      label<-switch(threshold,pr="Response ≥PR",vgpr="Response ≥VGPR",cr="Response CR/sCR")
      response<-paste0("response_",threshold)
      miss[[length(miss)+1L]]<-tf_ash_missingness(d,response,scenario)
      for(adjusted in c(FALSE,TRUE))add_model(d,response,c("flare",if(adjusted)tf_ash_covariates),"flare",
        paste(label,if(adjusted)"(adjusted)" else "(unadjusted)"),"Response",scenario,
        paste(scenario,response,if(adjusted)"adjusted" else "unadjusted",sep="_"))
    }
    fields<-c("crs_1","icans_1","toci_treatment","toci_prophylaxis","any_admission","infection_30d","severe_infection_30d")
    labels<-c("Any CRS","Any ICANS","Treatment tocilizumab","Prophylactic tocilizumab","Any admission","Infection within 30 days","Severe infection within 30 days")
    # These are post-treatment course-level comparisons, never baseline predictors.
    for(k in seq_along(fields)) {
      field<-fields[k];z<-d[!is.na(d[[field]]),,drop=FALSE]
      tab<-table(factor(z$flare,levels=0:1),factor(z[[field]],levels=0:1))
      test<-if(nrow(z)&&all(rowSums(tab)>0))stats::fisher.test(tab) else NULL
      clinical[[length(clinical)+1L]]<-data.frame(scenario=scenario,field=field,label=labels[k],
        flare_yes=tab[2,2],flare_evaluable=sum(tab[2,]),flare_total=sum(d$flare),
        comparison_yes=tab[1,2],comparison_evaluable=sum(tab[1,]),comparison_total=sum(d$flare==0),
        fisher_p=if(!is.null(test))test$p.value else NA_real_,
        interpretation="Exploratory post-treatment association; Fisher test assumes independent courses")
    }
    z<-d[!is.na(d$hospital_days_admitted),,drop=FALSE]
    # Match the abstract's admitted-course comparison. This course-level rank test
    # is exploratory and does not provide patient-cluster-adjusted inference.
    los_test<-if(all(c(0,1) %in% z$flare))tryCatch(stats::wilcox.test(
      hospital_days_admitted ~ flare,data=z,exact=FALSE),error=function(e)NULL) else NULL
    for(group in c(0,1)) {
      days<-z$hospital_days_admitted[z$flare==group]
      los[[length(los)+1L]]<-data.frame(scenario=scenario,group=if(group)"Flare candidate" else "No included flare",
        admitted_evaluable=length(days),total_courses=sum(d$flare==group),
        median=if(length(days))median(days) else NA_real_,q1=if(length(days))unname(quantile(days,.25)) else NA_real_,
        q3=if(length(days))unname(quantile(days,.75)) else NA_real_,
        wilcoxon_p=if(!is.null(los_test))los_test$p.value else NA_real_,
        test_status=if(!is.null(los_test))"Exploratory; assumes independent courses" else "Not estimable: both groups required",
        definition="Numeric total hospital days among recorded admissions; zero-day outpatient courses excluded; no flare-attributable duration inferred")
    }
  }
  table<-dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(models,`[[`,"table"))
  table$sparse_note<-vapply(seq_len(nrow(table)),function(i) {
    r<-table[i,]
    if(r$response=="flare"&&r$candidates<5L)return(paste("Only",r$candidates,"flare candidates; sparse exploratory estimate"))
    if(r$family=="Response") {
      counts<-c(r$candidate_events,r$candidates-r$candidate_events)
      if(any(counts<5L))return(paste0("Sparse candidate response cells: ",counts[1]," above and ",counts[2]," below threshold"))
    }
    ""
  },character(1))
  table$lab_bh_p<-NA_real_
  for(scenario in names(cohorts)) {
    hit<-table$scenario==scenario&table$family=="Laboratory"
    table$lab_bh_p[hit]<-stats::p.adjust(table$p_value[hit],method="BH",n=5L)
  }
  survival<-tf_ash_survival(analysis,cohorts,data)
  result<-list(models=table,bootstrap_diagnostics=dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(models,`[[`,"diagnostics")),
    model_membership=dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(models,`[[`,"membership")),missingness=dplyr::bind_rows(miss),
    survival=survival$table,survival_membership=survival$membership,landmark_sensitivity=survival$landmark_table,
    clinical=dplyr::bind_rows(clinical),hospitalization=dplyr::bind_rows(los),
    specs=specs,parameters=list(bootstrap_replicates=B,minimum_successes=ceiling(.9*B),seed=seed,
      logistf_version=as.character(utils::packageVersion("logistf")),adjustment_variables=tf_ash_covariates))
  for(name in names(result)[vapply(result,is.data.frame,logical(1))])utils::write.csv(result[[name]],
    file.path(output_dir,paste0("ash_",name,".csv")),row.names=FALSE,na="")
  jsonlite::write_json(result$parameters,file.path(output_dir,"ash_model_parameters.json"),auto_unbox=TRUE,pretty=TRUE)
  result
}
summary_functions.R
# Aggregate manuscript display exports and restricted row-level analytical audit.
tf_write <- function(d,output_dir,name)utils::write.csv(d,file.path(output_dir,paste0(name,".csv")),row.names=FALSE,na="")

tf_counts <- function(cases,fields,labels,sections,groups=TRUE) {
  populations<-list(All=cases)
  if(groups) {
    populations[["Definite/Probable"]]<-cases[cases$investigator_confidence %in% c("Definite","Probable"),,drop=FALSE]
    populations[["Possible"]]<-cases[cases$investigator_confidence %in% "Possible",,drop=FALSE]
  }
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(populations),function(group)dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(fields),function(i) {
    z<-populations[[group]];values<-tf_category(z[[fields[i]]]);t<-table(values)
    data.frame(group=group,section=sections[i],panel=sections[i],field=fields[i],label=labels[i],
      category=names(t),n=as.integer(t),denominator=nrow(z),percent=100*as.integer(t)/nrow(z),stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  }))))
}

tf_export_descriptive <- function(a,out) {
  x<-a$master;c<-a$cases;p<-a$cohorts$primary;s<-a$cohorts$strict
  tf_write(x,out,"canonical_courses_restricted")
  tf_write(c,out,"canonical_cases_restricted")
  tf_write(a$provenance,out,"field_provenance_restricted")
  tf_write(a$register,out,"reconciliation_register_restricted")
  flow<-data.frame(stage=c("Master courses","Supported agents","First eligible BCMA / all GPRC5D courses",
    "Nonbridging eligible courses","Excluded: flare status unavailable","Primary known-status courses",
    "Primary suspected flare","Primary comparison","Definite/Probable-only courses","Definite/Probable-only flare",
    "Clinical returned series","Clinical bridging cases","Clinical later BCMA cases"),
    courses=c(nrow(x),sum(x$product_key %in% tf_supported_products),sum(x$product_key %in% tf_supported_products&x$keep_first_bcma),
    nrow(a$eligible),sum(is.na(a$eligible$analysis_flare)),nrow(p),sum(p$analysis_flare),sum(!p$analysis_flare),nrow(s),sum(s$analysis_flare),
    nrow(c),sum(c$bridging_any,na.rm=TRUE),sum(!c$keep_first_bcma&!c$bridging_any,na.rm=TRUE)))
  tf_write(flow,out,"flow")
  coverage<-dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(unique(x$site),function(site) {
    z<-x[x$site==site,,drop=FALSE];e<-a$eligible[a$eligible$site==site,,drop=FALSE];d<-c[c$site==site,,drop=FALSE]
    data.frame(site=site,master_courses=nrow(z),eligible_courses=nrow(e),unknown_flare=sum(is.na(e$analysis_flare)),
      known_flare_status=sum(!is.na(e$analysis_flare)),original_flags=sum(z$original_flare,na.rm=TRUE),
      returned_records=nrow(d),returned_candidates=sum(d$analysis_flare,na.rm=TRUE))
  }))
  tf_write(coverage,out,"coverage")
  incidence<-dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(a$cohorts),function(scenario)tf_incidence(a$cohorts[[scenario]],scenario)))
  incidence<-incidence[incidence$product=="Overall",,drop=FALSE];tf_write(incidence,out,"incidence")
  specs<-c(product="Agent",age="Age (years)",sex="Sex",race="Race",ecog="ECOG",emd="Baseline disease location",
    prior_lots="Prior treatment lines",prior_asct="Prior ASCT",prior_cart="Prior CAR-T",prior_bcma="Prior BCMA therapy",
    prior_gprc5d="Prior GPRC5D therapy",high_marrow="High marrow burden",oligosecretory="Oligo/nonsecretory",
    hrca="At least one HRCA",triple_refractory="Triple refractory",penta_refractory="Penta refractory",
    hgb="Hemoglobin (g/dL)",ldh="LDH (U/L)",albumin="Albumin (g/dL)",igg="IgG (mg/dL)",ferritin="Ferritin (ng/mL)",crp="CRP (mg/L)")
  baseline<-dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(a$cohorts),function(scenario)dplyr::mutate(tf_summary_fields(a$cohorts[[scenario]],specs),scenario=scenario)))
  # Categorical known selections use the variable's available denominator.
  # Missing selections show their fraction of the complete group separately.
  baseline$evaluable<-baseline$n
  for(scenario in names(a$cohorts))for(measure in unname(specs)) {
    field<-names(specs)[match(measure,specs)]
    if(is.numeric(a$cohorts[[scenario]][[field]]))next
    all_categories<-unique(baseline$category[baseline$scenario==scenario&baseline$measure==measure])
    for(group in c("All","Flare candidate","No included flare")) {
      d<-a$cohorts[[scenario]]
      if(group!="All")d<-d[d$analysis_flare==(group=="Flare candidate"),,drop=FALSE]
      values<-tf_category(d[[field]])
      available<-sum(!values %in% c("Blank","Unknown","Not applicable","NE/Unknown","Not reassessed"))
      rows<-which(baseline$scenario==scenario&baseline$measure==measure&baseline$group==group)
      absent<-setdiff(all_categories,baseline$category[rows])
      if(length(absent)) {
        extra<-baseline[rep(rows[1],length(absent)),,drop=FALSE]
        extra$category<-absent;extra$n<-0L;extra$summary<-NA_character_
        baseline<-rbind(baseline,extra)
        rows<-which(baseline$scenario==scenario&baseline$measure==measure&baseline$group==group)
      }
      baseline$evaluable[rows]<-available
      missing<-baseline$category[rows] %in% c("Blank","Unknown","Not applicable","NE/Unknown","Not reassessed")
      denominators<-ifelse(missing,nrow(d),available)
      baseline$percent[rows]<-ifelse(denominators>0,100*baseline$n[rows]/denominators,NA_real_)
    }
  }
  tf_write(baseline,out,"table1_baseline")
  fields<-c("management_steroids","management_radiation","management_surgery","management_toci_anakinra",
    "management_nonopioid","management_opioids","bsab_action","resolution_status","local_lesion_outcome",
    "first_postflare_response","subsequent_response","best_index_response","improved_while_bsab_continued")
  labels<-c("Corticosteroids","Radiation","Surgery/procedure","Tocilizumab/anakinra","Non-opioid analgesia","Opioid analgesia",
    "BsAb action","Symptom-resolution status","Local-lesion outcome","First postflare systemic assessment",
    "Later supported systemic response","Best documented index-BsAb response","Improved without permanent BsAb discontinuation")
  sections<-c(rep("Interventions",6),"BsAb treatment",rep("Subsequent course",6))
  tf_write(tf_counts(c,fields,labels,sections),out,"table2_clinical_course")
  fields<-c("pain_flare","palpable_enlargement","imaging_worsening","new_lesion","neurologic_cns","biochemical_or_organ",
    "organ_dysfunction","flare_hospitalization","neurologic_deficit","pathologic_fracture","cord_compression","icu_due_to_flare")
  labels<-c("Pain","Palpable enlargement","Imaging worsening","New lesion","Neurological manifestation","Biochemical/organ manifestation",
    "Organ dysfunction","Primary flare admission","Neurological deficit","Pathological fracture","Cord compression","Primary flare ICU")
  tf_write(tf_counts(c,fields,labels,c(rep("Presentation",6),rep("Clinical impact",6)),FALSE),out,"presentation")
  fields<-c("focality","known_or_new_site","skeletal_flare_type","true_emd_classification","paraskeletal_involvement","spinal_involvement","cns_involvement")
  labels<-c("Extent","Known/new disease site","Skeletal pattern","True EMD","Paraskeletal involvement","Spinal involvement","CNS involvement")
  tf_write(tf_counts(c,fields,labels,rep("Anatomy",length(fields)),FALSE),out,"anatomy")
  anatomy_plot<-c
  anatomy_plot$true_emd_any<-ifelse(c$true_emd_classification %in% c("Visceral EMD (organ involvement)","Non-visceral EMD (no organ involvement)","Both visceral and non-visceral EMD"),"Yes",ifelse(c$true_emd_classification %in% "No true EMD","No","Unknown"))
  tf_write(tf_counts(anatomy_plot,c("paraskeletal_involvement","true_emd_any","spinal_involvement","cns_involvement"),
    c("Paraskeletal involvement","True EMD","Spinal involvement","CNS involvement"),rep("Anatomy",4),FALSE),out,"anatomy_binary")
  start<-x$start_date[match(c$course_id,x$course_id)]
  timeline<-data.frame(case_id=c$case_id,course_id=c$course_id,product=c$bsab_product,confidence=c$investigator_confidence,
    bridging=c$bridging_any,comparative_included=c$comparative_included,
    onset_day=as.numeric(c$flare_onset_date-start),peak_day=as.numeric(c$flare_peak_date-start),
    resolution_day=as.numeric(c$flare_resolution_date-start),onset_lower_day=as.numeric(c$onset_lower_date-start),
    onset_upper_day=as.numeric(c$onset_upper_date-start),onset_estimated=c$onset_estimated,peak_estimated=c$peak_estimated,
    resolution_estimated=c$resolution_estimated,symptom_status=c$resolution_status,local_outcome=c$local_lesion_outcome)
  timeline$case_label<-timeline$case_id
  timeline$onset_days<-timeline$onset_day;timeline$peak_days<-timeline$peak_day;timeline$resolution_days<-timeline$resolution_day
  timeline$onset_lower<-timeline$onset_lower_day;timeline$onset_upper<-timeline$onset_upper_day
  tf_write(timeline,out,"case_timeline")
  days<-timeline$onset_day[!is.na(timeline$onset_day)]
  timing<-data.frame(metric=c("Clinical series","Point onset available","Recorded peak available","Resolution date available","Median onset days","Minimum onset days","Maximum onset days","Onset by day 7","Onset by day 14","Onset by day 30"),
    value=c(nrow(c),length(days),sum(!is.na(timeline$peak_day)),sum(!is.na(timeline$resolution_day)),median(days),min(days),max(days),sum(days<=7),sum(days<=14),sum(days<=30)),
    denominator=c(nrow(c),nrow(c),nrow(c),nrow(c),length(days),length(days),length(days),length(days),length(days),length(days)))
  tf_write(timing,out,"timing_summary")
  summary<-timeline[,setdiff(names(timeline),"course_id"),drop=FALSE]
  for(field in c("pain_flare","palpable_enlargement","imaging_worsening","new_lesion","neurologic_cns","biochemical_or_organ",
    "focality","known_or_new_site","skeletal_flare_type","paraskeletal_involvement","true_emd_classification","cns_involvement",
    "spinal_involvement","organ_dysfunction","flare_hospitalization","icu_due_to_flare","pathologic_fracture","cord_compression",
    "overlap_crs","overlap_icans","overlap_infection","alternative_fracture","alternative_toxicity","other_competing_explanation",
    "bsab_action","management_steroids","management_radiation","management_surgery","management_toci_anakinra",
    "first_postflare_response","subsequent_response","best_index_response","true_pd_within_14d","alternative_diagnosis"))summary[[field]]<-c[[field]]
  for(field in intersect(c("first_response_on_index","subsequent_response_on_index"),names(c)))summary[[field]]<-c[[field]]
  tf_write(summary,out,"case_summary")
  changes<-a$register[!startsWith(a$register$field,"case."),,drop=FALSE]
  change_summary<-as.data.frame(table(changes$field));names(change_summary)<-c("field","change_events")
  tf_write(change_summary,out,"reconciliation_summary")
}

tf_export_models <- function(a,m,out) {
  mapping<-c(models="models",bootstrap_diagnostics="bootstrap_diagnostics",missingness="missingness",
    survival="survival_models",clinical="clinical_comparisons",hospitalization="hospitalization",landmark_sensitivity="landmark_models")
  for(field in names(mapping))tf_write(m[[field]],out,mapping[[field]])
  tf_write(m$model_membership,out,"model_membership_restricted")
  tf_write(m$survival_membership,out,"survival_membership_restricted")
  thresholds<-dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(a$cohorts),function(scenario) {
