    d<-a$cohorts[[scenario]]
    dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(c(FALSE,TRUE),function(group) {
      z<-d[d$analysis_flare==group,,drop=FALSE];known<-z$analysis_response %in% tf_response_levels[1:7]
      dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(c("pr","vgpr","cr"),function(threshold) {
        levels<-switch(threshold,pr=tf_response_levels[1:4],vgpr=tf_response_levels[1:3],cr=tf_response_levels[1:2])
        n<-sum(known);responders<-sum(z$analysis_response %in% levels);ci<-if(n)binom.test(responders,n)$conf.int else c(NA,NA)
        data.frame(scenario=scenario,group=if(group)"Flare candidate"else"No included flare",threshold=threshold,responders=responders,
          evaluable=n,total_courses=nrow(z),unavailable=nrow(z)-n,percent=if(n)100*responders/n else NA,
          lower_95_percent=100*ci[1],upper_95_percent=100*ci[2])
      }))
    }))
  }))
  tf_write(thresholds,out,"response_thresholds")
  distribution<-dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(a$cohorts),function(scenario) {
    d<-a$cohorts[[scenario]]
    dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(c(FALSE,TRUE),function(group) {
      z<-d[d$analysis_flare==group,,drop=FALSE];known<-z$analysis_response %in% tf_response_levels[1:7]
      categories<-c(tf_response_levels[1:7],"Unavailable")
      n<-vapply(categories,function(category)if(category=="Unavailable")sum(!known)else sum(z$analysis_response==category,na.rm=TRUE),integer(1))
      evaluable<-sum(known)
      data.frame(scenario=scenario,group=if(group)"Flare candidate"else"No included flare",category=categories,n=n,
        evaluable=evaluable,total_courses=nrow(z),unavailable=sum(!known),
        percent=ifelse(categories=="Unavailable",100*n/nrow(z),if(evaluable)100*n/evaluable else NA_real_))
    }))
  }))
  tf_write(distribution,out,"response_distribution")
  km<-risk<-landmark_rows<-endpoint_audit<-list()
  cohorts<-tf_survival_scenarios(a,c(a$cohorts,list(without_dominant_site=
    a$cohorts$primary[!a$cohorts$primary$site_key %in% a$excluded_site_keys,,drop=FALSE])))
  for(scenario in names(cohorts))for(endpoint in c("PFS","OS")) {
    d<-cohorts[[scenario]][c("course_id","patient_cluster_id","start_date","pd_date","death_date","last_contact_date","analysis_flare","onset_date")]
    exclusions<-cohorts[[scenario]]$course_id[cohorts[[scenario]]$pfs_excluded]
    run<-edc_landmark_analysis(d,endpoint,pfs_exclude_course_ids=exclusions)
    run$data$scenario<-scenario;landmark_rows[[length(landmark_rows)+1L]]<-run$data
    er<-edc_build_endpoint(d,endpoint,pfs_exclude_course_ids=exclusions)$audit
    er$scenario<-scenario;endpoint_audit[[length(endpoint_audit)+1L]]<-er
    if(scenario=="primary")for(day in c(30,60))for(group in c(0,1)) {
      z<-run$data[run$data$landmark_day==day&run$data$flare_by_landmark==group,,drop=FALSE]
      if(!nrow(z))next
      fit<-survival::survfit(survival::Surv(time_after_landmark_months,status)~1,data=z,conf.type="log-log")
      km[[length(km)+1L]]<-data.frame(endpoint=endpoint,landmark_day=day,group=group,
        time=c(0,fit$time),survival=c(1,fit$surv),lower=c(1,fit$lower),upper=c(1,fit$upper))
      times<-c(0,6,12,24,36,48)
      risk[[length(risk)+1L]]<-data.frame(endpoint=endpoint,landmark_day=day,group=group,time=times,
        n_risk=vapply(times,function(t)sum(z$time_after_landmark_months>=t),integer(1)))
    }
  }
  tf_write(dplyr::bind_rows(km),out,"landmark_km_steps")
  tf_write(dplyr::bind_rows(risk),out,"landmark_risk_counts")
  tf_write(dplyr::bind_rows(landmark_rows),out,"landmark_data_restricted")
  tf_write(dplyr::bind_rows(endpoint_audit),out,"endpoint_audit_restricted")
  final<-a$provenance[a$provenance$is_final_record,,drop=FALSE]
  endpoint_provenance<-list()
  for(endpoint in c("PFS","OS")) {
    d<-edc_build_endpoint(a$master[c("course_id","patient_cluster_id","start_date","pd_date","death_date","last_contact_date","analysis_flare","onset_date")],
      endpoint,pfs_exclude_course_ids=a$master$course_id[a$master$pfs_excluded])$audit
    inputs<-c("start_date",if(endpoint=="PFS")"pd_date","death_date","last_contact_date",if(endpoint=="PFS")"pfs_excluded")
    by_course<-split(final[final$field %in% inputs,,drop=FALSE],final$course_id[final$field %in% inputs])
    refs<-vapply(d$course_id,function(id) {
      r<-by_course[[id]]
      if(is.null(r))return("")
      paste(paste0(r$field,": ",r$source_file," [",r$source_sheet,", row ",r$source_row,"]",
        ifelse(nzchar(r$clarification_pointer),paste0("; ",r$clarification_pointer),""),
        ifelse(nzchar(r$controlled_rule_pointer),paste0("; ",r$controlled_rule_pointer),"")),collapse=" | ")
    },character(1))
    for(field in c("event_date","observed_date","status","followup_days","endpoint_eligible","endpoint_exclusion_reason")) {
      values<-d[[field]]
      if(field %in% c("observed_date","status","followup_days"))values[!d$endpoint_eligible]<-NA
      endpoint_provenance[[length(endpoint_provenance)+1L]]<-data.frame(course_id=d$course_id,field=paste(endpoint,field,sep="."),
        source="Derived from canonical endpoint fields",source_field=paste(inputs,collapse="; "),source_value=tf_value_text(values),
        source_state=ifelse(!d$endpoint_eligible,"Analytically excluded; no inferred censoring",tf_source_state(values)),
        original_master_value="",canonical_value=tf_value_text(values),changed=FALSE,
        reason=ifelse(d$endpoint_eligible,"Canonical event/censor derivation after authoritative source reconciliation",d$endpoint_exclusion_reason),
        source_file="",source_sheet="",source_row="",clarification_pointer="",controlled_rule_pointer="",supporting_references=refs)
    }
  }
  records<-dplyr::bind_rows(a$provenance,dplyr::bind_rows(endpoint_provenance))
  records$record_order<-seq_len(nrow(records));records$is_final_record<-!duplicated(paste(records$course_id,records$field),fromLast=TRUE)
  tf_write(records,out,"field_provenance_restricted")
  attribution_path<-file.path(a$project_root,"response_attribution_review_restricted.csv")
  if(file.exists(attribution_path))invisible(file.copy(attribution_path,file.path(out,"response_attribution_review_restricted.csv"),overwrite=TRUE))
}

tf_write_analysis_summary <- function(a,m,out) {
  p<-a$cohorts$primary;c<-a$cases
  inc<-tf_incidence(p,"primary");inc<-inc[inc$product=="Overall",,drop=FALSE]
  response<-utils::read.csv(file.path(out,"response_thresholds.csv"),stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  old<-a$original$analysis_response[match(c$course_id,a$original$course_id)]
  new<-c$best_index_response
  survival<-m$survival[m$survival$scenario=="primary"&startsWith(m$survival$model,"Adjusted"),,drop=FALSE]
  emd<-m$models[m$models$scenario=="primary"&m$models$model_id=="primary_true_emd",,drop=FALSE]
  result<-list(counts=list(master=nrow(a$master),eligible=nrow(a$eligible),unknown_flare=sum(is.na(a$eligible$analysis_flare)),
    comparative=nrow(p),flare=sum(p$analysis_flare),comparison=sum(!p$analysis_flare),clinical=nrow(c),sites=length(unique(c$site)),
    strict_courses=nrow(a$cohorts$strict),strict_flare=sum(a$cohorts$strict$analysis_flare)),
    confidence=as.list(table(c$investigator_confidence)),products=as.list(table(c$bsab_product)),incidence=inc,
    timing=utils::read.csv(file.path(out,"timing_summary.csv")),response_thresholds=response[response$scenario=="primary",],
    response_changes=list(all_returned=sum(tf_value_text(old)!=tf_value_text(new)),
      comparative=sum(tf_value_text(old[c$comparative_included])!=tf_value_text(new[c$comparative_included])),
      canonical_unavailable=sum(p$analysis_flare&!p$analysis_response %in% tf_response_levels[1:7])),
    emd=emd,adjusted_survival=survival,bootstrap=list(models=nrow(m$models),requested=m$parameters$bootstrap_replicates,
      minimum_successes=m$parameters$minimum_successes,success_range=range(m$bootstrap_diagnostics$successful)),
    pfs_excluded_returned=sum(a$master$pfs_excluded&a$master$edc_received),
    pfs_excluded_comparative=sum(p$pfs_excluded),source_policy="Returned EDC/site clarification is authoritative; master supplies separate uncollected, noncontradicted concepts",
    survival_sensitivities=setdiff(unique(m$survival$scenario),"original_master_endpoints"),
    historical_endpoint_audit="original_master_endpoints is an audit of superseded values; not a clinically valid sensitivity or canonical inference",
    response_attribution=list(reviewed_courses=nrow(c),reviewed_assessments=2L*nrow(c),
      policy="Only accepted index-course categories enter response thresholds. Local-only, unconfirmed, post-salvage and post-CAR-T observations do not supply a category."))
  jsonlite::write_json(result,file.path(out,"analysis_summary.json"),auto_unbox=TRUE,dataframe="rows",pretty=TRUE,na="null")
}
ground_truth_tests.R
# Generic regression scenarios for precedence, scope, endpoints, and resampling.
tf_ground_truth_tests <- function(master,cases,rules,analysis) {
  results<-list()
  check<-function(name,value)results[[length(results)+1L]]<<-data.frame(test=name,status=if(isTRUE(value))"PASS"else"FAIL")
  x<-analysis$master;c<-analysis$cases;p<-analysis$cohorts$primary;s<-analysis$cohorts$strict
  check("Every authoritative return has a canonical record",nrow(c)==nrow(cases)&&setequal(c$course_id,cases$course_id))
  check("Unique normalized course and case identities",!anyDuplicated(x$course_id)&&!anyDuplicated(c$case_id))
  check("Primary classified eligibility",all(p$eligibility_verified&p$keep_first_bcma&!p$bridging_any)&&!anyNA(p$analysis_flare))
  check("Strict excludes Possible without making controls",!any(s$investigator_confidence %in% "Possible")&&sum(!s$analysis_flare)==sum(!p$analysis_flare))
  j<-match(cases$course_id,x$course_id)
  check("Returned canonical start uses EDC including missing",identical(x$start_date[j],cases$step_up_day1))
  check("Returned product uses EDC",identical(x$product[j],as.character(cases$bsab_product)))
  expected<-vapply(seq_len(nrow(cases)),function(i)tf_best_index_response(cases$first_postflare_response[i],cases$subsequent_response[i],cases$first_response_on_index[i],cases$subsequent_response_on_index[i]),character(1))
  check("All returned responses use site assessments",identical(x$analysis_response[j],expected))
  check("Original master preserved",identical(master$analysis_response,analysis$original$analysis_response[match(master$course_id,analysis$original$course_id)]))
  check("Final provenance has one authoritative record per field",!anyDuplicated(paste(analysis$provenance$course_id[analysis$provenance$is_final_record],
    analysis$provenance$field[analysis$provenance$is_final_record])))
  check("Final first-course provenance reflects recomputed eligibility",all(x$course_id %in%
    analysis$provenance$course_id[analysis$provenance$field=="keep_first_bcma"&analysis$provenance$is_final_record&
    analysis$provenance$source=="Derived from canonical source fields"]))
  check("Final infection-window provenance records canonical derivation",all(x$course_id %in%
    analysis$provenance$course_id[analysis$provenance$field=="infection_30d"&analysis$provenance$is_final_record&
    analysis$provenance$source=="Derived from canonical source fields"]))
  if(all(c("source_file","source_sheet","source_row") %in% names(cases))) {
    r<-analysis$provenance[analysis$provenance$source=="EDC"&analysis$provenance$field=="analysis_response",,drop=FALSE]
    q<-match(r$course_id,cases$course_id)
    check("EDC response provenance preserves file sheet and row",identical(r$source_file,tf_value_text(cases$source_file[q]))&&
      identical(r$source_sheet,tf_value_text(cases$source_sheet[q]))&&identical(r$source_row,tf_value_text(cases$source_row[q])))
  }
  check("Known response does not upgrade from master",tf_best_index_response("PR","Unknown")=="PR")
  check("Later formal response supersedes first apparent PD",tf_best_index_response("PD","PR")=="PR")
  check("Salvage response excluded",tf_best_index_response("MR","CR",TRUE,FALSE)=="MR")
  check("Unknown response stays unavailable",tf_best_index_response("Unknown","Not reassessed")=="NE/Unknown")
  fixture<-cases[1,,drop=FALSE];mm<-master
  k<-match(fixture$course_id,mm$course_id)
  mm$analysis_response[k]<-"CR";fixture$first_postflare_response<-"Unknown";fixture$subsequent_response<-NA_character_
  z<-tf_reconcile(mm,fixture,trace=FALSE)
  check("Unknown/blank EDC never backfilled from master response",z$master$analysis_response[k]=="NE/Unknown")
  fixture$step_up_day1<-as.Date(NA_character_);z<-tf_reconcile(mm,fixture,trace=FALSE)
  check("Missing EDC start never backfilled",is.na(z$master$start_date[k]))
  fixture<-cases[1,,drop=FALSE];fixture$investigator_confidence<-NA_character_;z<-tf_reconcile(mm,fixture,trace=FALSE)
  check("Missing returned classification never inherits original flag",is.na(z$master$analysis_flare[k])&&!fixture$course_id %in% z$cohorts$primary$course_id)
  fixture$investigator_confidence<-"Not tumor flare";mm$original_flare[k]<-TRUE;mm$analysis_flare[k]<-TRUE;z<-tf_reconcile(mm,fixture,trace=FALSE)
  check("Site negative classification overrides master positive",identical(z$master$analysis_flare[k],FALSE))
  fixture<-cases[1,,drop=FALSE];fixture$flare_hospitalization<-"Yes";mm$any_admission[k]<-FALSE;z<-tf_reconcile(mm,fixture,trace=FALSE)
  check("Positive scoped admission establishes course admission",isTRUE(z$master$any_admission[k]))
  mm$hospital_days[k]<-0;z<-tf_reconcile(mm,fixture,trace=FALSE)
  check("Contradicted zero total admission days becomes unavailable",is.na(z$master$hospital_days[k])&&isTRUE(z$master$any_admission[k]))
  fixture$flare_hospitalization<-"No";mm$any_admission[k]<-TRUE;z<-tf_reconcile(mm,fixture,trace=FALSE)
  check("Negative scoped admission preserves other course admissions",isTRUE(z$master$any_admission[k]))
  fixture<-cases[1,,drop=FALSE];fixture$overlap_crs<-"Yes";fixture$overlap_icans<-"Yes"
  mm$crs_grade[k]<-mm$icans_grade[k]<-0;mm$crs_1[k]<-mm$icans_1[k]<-FALSE
  mm$crs_2[k]<-mm$crs_3[k]<-mm$icans_2[k]<-mm$icans_3[k]<-FALSE
  z<-tf_reconcile(mm,fixture,trace=FALSE)
  check("Positive CRS with zero master grade preserves unknown severity",isTRUE(z$master$crs_1[k])&&is.na(z$master$crs_grade[k])&&is.na(z$master$crs_2[k])&&is.na(z$master$crs_3[k]))
  check("Positive ICANS with zero master grade preserves unknown severity",isTRUE(z$master$icans_1[k])&&is.na(z$master$icans_grade[k])&&is.na(z$master$icans_2[k])&&is.na(z$master$icans_3[k]))
  fixture<-cases[1,,drop=FALSE];fixture$overlap_infection<-"Yes";mm$infection_flag[k]<-FALSE;mm$infection_count[k]<-0
  for(v in paste0("infection_date_",1:7))mm[[v]][k]<-as.Date(NA_character_)
  z<-tf_reconcile(mm,fixture,trace=FALSE)
  check("Scoped infection invalidates zero count and negative windows",isTRUE(z$master$infection_flag[k])&&is.na(z$master$infection_count[k])&&is.na(z$master$infection_30d[k])&&is.na(z$master$severe_infection_30d[k]))
  fixture<-cases[1,,drop=FALSE];fixture$first_postflare_response<-"MR";fixture$subsequent_response<-"CR";fixture$subsequent_response_on_index<-FALSE
  correction<-data.frame(course_id=fixture$course_id,field="subsequent_response_on_index",value="TRUE",action="set",reason="Fixture index attribution clarified")
  z<-tf_reconcile(master,fixture,correction,trace=FALSE)
  check("Case attribution clarification precedes best-response derivation",z$master$analysis_response[k]=="CR")
  fixture<-cases[1,,drop=FALSE];fixture$step_up_day1<-as.Date("2000-01-01");fixture$flare_onset_date<-as.Date("2000-01-03")
  fixture$first_postflare_response<-"PD";fixture$first_postflare_response_date<-as.Date("2000-01-08");fixture$true_pd_within_14d<-"Yes"
  z<-tf_reconcile(master,fixture,trace=FALSE)
  check("Site-confirmed true early PD supplies endpoint date",z$master$pd_date[k]==as.Date("2000-01-08"))
  fixture$true_pd_within_14d<-"No";z<-tf_reconcile(master,fixture,trace=FALSE)
  check("Apparent assessment PD not promoted to true endpoint",identical(z$master$pd_date[k],master$pd_date[k]))
  correction<-data.frame(course_id=fixture$course_id,field=c("pd_date","pfs_excluded"),value=c(NA,"TRUE"),action=c("invalidate","set"),reason="Fixture unresolved endpoint")
  z<-tf_reconcile(master,fixture,correction,trace=FALSE)
  check("Contradicted progression remains unavailable",is.na(z$master$pd_date[k])&&isTRUE(z$master$pfs_excluded[k]))
  d<-z$master[k,c("course_id","patient_cluster_id","start_date","pd_date","death_date","last_contact_date","analysis_flare","onset_date")]
  ep<-edc_build_endpoint(d,"PFS",pfs_exclude_course_ids=fixture$course_id)
  check("Invalidated PFS not converted to censoring",nrow(ep$data)==0L&&nrow(ep$exclusions)==1L)
  fixture$course_id<-"NEW_CASE";fixture$case_id<-"NEW_RETURN";z<-tf_reconcile(master,fixture,trace=FALSE)
  check("EDC-only return retained descriptively",fixture$course_id %in% z$cases$course_id)
  check("Unverified EDC-only denominator not invented",!fixture$course_id %in% z$cohorts$primary$course_id)
  duplicate_error<-tryCatch({tf_reconcile(master,rbind(cases,cases[1,]));FALSE},error=function(e)TRUE)
  check("Duplicate authoritative return rejected",duplicate_error)
  set.seed(99);idx<-tf_ash_cluster_indices(c("a","a","b","c","c"));multiplicity<-tabulate(idx,nbins=5)
  check("Bootstrap samples all courses within patient blocks",multiplicity[1]==multiplicity[2]&&multiplicity[4]==multiplicity[5])
  set.seed(5);draws<-rnorm(1000)
  low<-tf_ash_bootstrap_inference(.5,c(draws[1:899],rep(NA_real_,101)),1000)
  boundary<-tf_ash_bootstrap_inference(.5,c(draws[1:900],rep(NA_real_,100)),1000)
  check("Bootstrap inference suppressed below minimum",!low$inference_available&&is.na(low$conf_low))
  check("Bootstrap inference available at minimum",boundary$inference_available&&is.finite(boundary$conf_low))
  fit<-tf_ash_firth_fit(data.frame(y=rep(0:1,each=20),v=rep(0:1,each=20)),"y","v","v")
  check("Firth handles complete separation",fit$converged&&is.finite(fit$coefficient))
  fit<-tf_ash_firth_fit(data.frame(y=rep(0,40),v=rep(0:1,each=20)),"y","v","v")
  check("No outcome variation reported nonestimable",!fit$converged)
  do.call(rbind,results)
}
Closed public case contract
"""Closed contract for the public categorical case object.

Every field is a predefined category, a neutral label, or a numeric elapsed value.
Free text and unexpected fields are rejected before any display or archive build.
"""
import csv
import json
import math
import re
from pathlib import Path

NUMERIC_FIELDS = ("onset_days", "peak_days", "resolution_days", "onset_lower", "onset_upper")
BOOL_FIELDS = ("bridging", "comparative_included", "onset_estimated", "peak_estimated", "resolution_estimated",
               "first_response_on_index", "subsequent_response_on_index")
BINARY_FIELDS = ("pain_flare", "palpable_enlargement", "imaging_worsening", "new_lesion", "neurologic_cns",
                 "biochemical_or_organ", "paraskeletal_involvement", "cns_involvement", "spinal_involvement",
                 "organ_dysfunction", "flare_hospitalization", "icu_due_to_flare", "pathologic_fracture",
                 "cord_compression", "overlap_crs", "overlap_icans", "overlap_infection", "alternative_fracture",
                 "alternative_toxicity", "other_competing_explanation", "management_steroids",
                 "management_radiation", "management_surgery", "management_toci_anakinra", "true_pd_within_14d")
VOCABULARY = {
    "product": ("Teclistamab", "Talquetamab", "Elranatamab", "Linvoseltamab"),
    "confidence": ("Definite", "Probable", "Possible"),
    "symptom_status": ("RESOLVED", "IMPROVED_ONGOING", "ONGOING_NOT_IMPROVED", "DEATH_BEFORE_RESOLUTION", "UNKNOWN"),
    "local_outcome": ("RESOLVED", "IMPROVED", "STABLE", "WORSENED", "NOT_REASSESSED", "UNKNOWN"),
    "focality": ("SINGLE_SITE", "MULTIFOCAL", "DIFFUSE_SYSTEMIC", "UNKNOWN"),
    "known_or_new_site": ("KNOWN_SITE", "NEW_SITE", "UNCLEAR"),
    "skeletal_flare_type": ("LYTIC", "MIXED", "NONE", "OTHER_OSSEOUS", "UNKNOWN"),
    "true_emd_classification": ("NONE", "NONVISCERAL", "VISCERAL", "VISCERAL_AND_NONVISCERAL", "NOT_APPLICABLE", "UNKNOWN"),
    "bsab_action": ("CONTINUED", "DELAYED", "HELD_RESUMED", "DISCONTINUED", "UNKNOWN"),
    "first_postflare_response": ("sCR", "CR", "VGPR", "PR", "MR", "SD", "PD", "NE", "UNKNOWN", "NOT_APPLICABLE"),
    "subsequent_response": ("sCR", "CR", "VGPR", "PR", "MR", "SD", "PD", "NE", "NONE_DOCUMENTED", "NOT_REASSESSED", "UNKNOWN", "NOT_APPLICABLE"),
    "best_index_response": ("sCR", "CR", "VGPR", "PR", "MR", "SD", "PD", "UNAVAILABLE"),
    "alternative_diagnosis": ("NONE_IDENTIFIED", "TRUE_PROGRESSION", "UNCERTAIN"),
    "onset_timing_type": ("RECORDED_POINT", "ESTIMATED_POINT", "INTERVAL", "UNAVAILABLE"),
    "peak_timing_type": ("RECORDED_POINT", "ESTIMATED_POINT", "UNAVAILABLE"),
    "resolution_timing_type": ("RECORDED_POINT", "ESTIMATED_POINT", "UNAVAILABLE"),
    "first_response_category_estimated": ("YES", "NO", "NOT_REPORTED"),
    "later_local_assessment_context": ("AFTER_RADIATION", "AFTER_SALVAGE", "AFTER_CART", "AFTER_RADIATION_AND_SALVAGE", "NOT_REPORTED"),
    "later_local_after_radiation": ("YES", "NO", "NOT_REPORTED"),
    "later_local_after_salvage": ("YES", "NO", "NOT_REPORTED"),
    "later_local_after_cart": ("YES", "NO", "NOT_REPORTED"),
    "later_local_separate_from_systemic_response": ("YES", "NOT_REPORTED"),
    "peak_before_point_onset": ("YES", "NO", "NOT_EVALUABLE"),
}
VOCABULARY.update({field: ("TRUE", "FALSE", "UNKNOWN") for field in BOOL_FIELDS})
VOCABULARY.update({field: ("YES", "NO", "UNKNOWN", "NOT_APPLICABLE") for field in BINARY_FIELDS})
FIELD_ORDER = ("case_label", "product", "confidence", "bridging", "comparative_included", *NUMERIC_FIELDS,
               "onset_estimated", "peak_estimated", "resolution_estimated", "onset_timing_type", "peak_timing_type",
               "resolution_timing_type", "symptom_status", "local_outcome", *BINARY_FIELDS,
               "focality", "known_or_new_site", "skeletal_flare_type", "true_emd_classification", "bsab_action",
               "first_postflare_response", "first_response_on_index", "first_response_category_estimated",
               "subsequent_response", "subsequent_response_on_index", "best_index_response", "alternative_diagnosis",
               "later_local_assessment_context", "later_local_after_radiation", "later_local_after_salvage",
               "later_local_after_cart", "later_local_separate_from_systemic_response", "peak_before_point_onset")
if len(FIELD_ORDER) != len(set(FIELD_ORDER)):
    raise RuntimeError("Duplicate public case contract fields")

def validate_cases(rows):
    if not rows:
        raise ValueError("Public case object is empty")
    labels = set()
    for row in rows:
        if set(row) != set(FIELD_ORDER):
            raise ValueError(f"Public case columns differ from closed contract: {set(row) ^ set(FIELD_ORDER)}")
        label = row["case_label"]
        if not re.fullmatch(r"TF[0-9]{2}", label) or label in labels:
            raise ValueError("Neutral public case labels must be unique TFnn values")
        labels.add(label)
        for field, allowed in VOCABULARY.items():
            if row[field] not in allowed:
                raise ValueError(f"Public case value outside finite vocabulary: {field}")
        for field in NUMERIC_FIELDS:
            value = row[field]
            if value == "":
                continue
            if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?", value) or not math.isfinite(float(value)) or float(value) > 36600:
                raise ValueError(f"Public chronology must be a finite nonnegative elapsed value: {field}")
        for event in ("onset", "peak", "resolution"):
            point = row[event + "_days"]
            timing = row[event + "_timing_type"]
            if timing in ("RECORDED_POINT", "ESTIMATED_POINT") and not point:
                raise ValueError("Point timing category requires an elapsed value")
            if timing in ("UNAVAILABLE", "INTERVAL") and point:
                raise ValueError("Unknown or interval timing cannot contain an inferred point")
            if timing == "ESTIMATED_POINT" and row[event + "_estimated"] != "TRUE":
                raise ValueError("Estimated timing must carry the corresponding flag")
            if timing == "RECORDED_POINT" and row[event + "_estimated"] != "FALSE":
                raise ValueError("Recorded timing must carry the corresponding flag")
        if row["onset_timing_type"] == "INTERVAL" and (not row["onset_lower"] or not row["onset_upper"] or float(row["onset_lower"]) > float(row["onset_upper"])):
            raise ValueError("Onset interval requires ordered elapsed bounds")
        if row["onset_timing_type"] != "INTERVAL" and (row["onset_lower"] or row["onset_upper"]):
            raise ValueError("Onset bounds require an interval timing category")
        contexts = {
            "NOT_REPORTED": ("NOT_REPORTED", "NOT_REPORTED", "NOT_REPORTED", "NOT_REPORTED"),
            "AFTER_RADIATION": ("YES", "NO", "NO", "YES"),
            "AFTER_SALVAGE": ("NO", "YES", "NO", "YES"),
            "AFTER_CART": ("NO", "NO", "YES", "YES"),
            "AFTER_RADIATION_AND_SALVAGE": ("YES", "YES", "NO", "YES"),
        }
        if tuple(row[field] for field in ("later_local_after_radiation", "later_local_after_salvage", "later_local_after_cart", "later_local_separate_from_systemic_response")) != contexts[row["later_local_assessment_context"]]:
            raise ValueError("Local-assessment treatment flags contradict the coded context")
        expected_peak = ("YES" if float(row["peak_days"]) < float(row["onset_days"]) else "NO") if row["peak_days"] and row["onset_days"] else "NOT_EVALUABLE"
        if row["peak_before_point_onset"] != expected_peak:
            raise ValueError("Chronology flag contradicts elapsed values")
    return rows

def read_coded_cases(path):
    with Path(path).open(newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig") as handle:
        return validate_cases(list(csv.DictReader(handle)))

def public_generic_source(filename, source):
    """Suppress narrative exports in the public copy without changing models."""
    if filename != "summary_functions.R":
        return source
    pattern = r'  for\(field in intersect\(c\("first_response_on_index".*?  tf_write\(summary,out,"case_summary"\)'
    replacement = ('  for(field in intersect(c("first_response_on_index","subsequent_response_on_index"),names(c)))summary[[field]]<-c[[field]]\n'
                   '  tf_write(summary,out,"case_summary")')
    result, count = re.subn(pattern, replacement, source, flags=re.S)
    if count != 1:
        raise ValueError("Public summary export suppression did not match its expected code boundary")
    return result

def write_contract(path):
    contract = {"schema": "tumor-flare-public-case-coded-v1", "fields": list(FIELD_ORDER),
                "neutral_label_pattern": "TF[0-9]{2}", "numeric_elapsed_fields": list(NUMERIC_FIELDS),
                "numeric_unit": "days after first step-up dose", "empty_numeric_value": "unavailable",
                "finite_category_vocabulary": {key: list(value) for key, value in VOCABULARY.items()},
                "local_assessment_not_reported": "Absence of a reported additional-treatment assessment does not establish absence of that treatment.",
                "response_attribution": "First and subsequent on-index flags qualify the corresponding response categories. Additional-treatment local assessments are separate from index-course systemic response.",
                "estimated_response_flag": "YES identifies a source-supported viewer-estimated response category. NOT_REPORTED means that estimation status is not established."}
    Path(path).write_text(json.dumps(contract, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")

def format_baseline() -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    source = read("table1_baseline", ("group", "measure", "category", "n", "evaluable", "denominator", "summary"))
    source = [row for row in source if row.get("scenario", "primary") == "primary" and row["group"] != "All"]
    groups = list(OrderedDict.fromkeys(row["group"] for row in source))
    if len(groups) != 2:
        raise ValueError(f"Table1 must contain exactly two primary groups, found {groups}")
    result: OrderedDict[tuple[str, str], dict[str, str]] = OrderedDict()
    measure_order = list(OrderedDict.fromkeys(row["measure"] for row in source))
    unavailable_categories = {"", "blank", "unknown", "not applicable", "missing", "na", "unavailable"}
    for row in source:
        key = row["measure"], row["category"]
        if key not in result:
            result[key] = {"Characteristic": row["measure"], "Category": row["category"]}
        is_unavailable = row["category"].strip().lower() in unavailable_categories
        denominator = row["denominator"] if is_unavailable else (row["evaluable"] or row["denominator"])
        if row["n"] and row["denominator"] and not 0 <= float(row["n"]) <= float(row["denominator"]):
            raise ValueError("Baseline numerator exceeds total group population")
        if row["summary"]:
            value = row["summary"]
            if denominator:
                value += f"; available n={number(denominator, 0)}"
        elif row["n"] and denominator and float(denominator) > 0:
            if not 0 <= float(row["n"]) <= float(denominator):
                raise ValueError("Baseline numerator exceeds its rendered denominator")
            percentage = str(100 * float(row["n"]) / float(denominator))
            value = f"{number(row['n'], 0)}/{number(denominator, 0)} ({number(percentage)}%)"
        else:
            value = "Not evaluable (0 available)" if denominator and float(denominator) == 0 else "Not available"
        result[key][row["group"]] = value
    for row in result.values():
        if not set(groups).issubset(row):
            raise ValueError("Canonical baseline category is missing a comparison group; zero categories must be explicit")
    return sorted(result.values(), key=lambda row: (measure_order.index(row["Characteristic"]),
        row["Category"].strip().lower() in unavailable_categories,
        row["Category"].casefold()))

def format_clinical_course() -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    source = read("table2_clinical_course", ("section", "field", "label", "category", "n", "denominator"))
    group_key = next((key for key in ("group", "confidence_group") if key in source[0]), None)
    if group_key is None:
        raise ValueError("Table2 requires all cases / Definite-Probable / Possible group fields")
    groups = list(OrderedDict.fromkeys(row[group_key] for row in source))
    if len(groups) != 3:
        raise ValueError(f"Table2 must contain three confidence groups, found {groups}")
    denominators = {group: {row["denominator"] for row in source if row[group_key] == group} for group in groups}
    if any(len(values) != 1 for values in denominators.values()):
        raise ValueError("Table2 must use a single total case denominator within each confidence group")
    result: OrderedDict[tuple[str, str, str], dict[str, str]] = OrderedDict()
    for row in source:
        key = row["section"], row["label"], row["category"]
        if key not in result:
            result[key] = {"Domain": row["section"], "Measure": row["label"], "Category": row["category"] or "Unknown"}
        n, denom = float(row["n"]), float(row["denominator"])
        if not 0 <= n <= denom or denom <= 0:
            raise ValueError(f"Invalid Table2 denominator: {row}")
        result[key][row[group_key]] = f"{n:.0f}/{denom:.0f} ({100*n/denom:.1f}%)"
    for row in result.values():
        for group in groups:
            row.setdefault(group, f"0/{number(next(iter(denominators[group])),0)} (0.0%)")
    return list(result.values())

Table S1. Structured characteristics of individual site-reviewed cases

Neutral case labels replace original identifiers. Every case value is a predefined code, category, or numeric elapsed value. Chronology uses days after first step-up dosing; timing codes identify recorded points, estimated points, onset intervals, and unavailable timing. Empty numeric entries mean unavailable. First and subsequent response attribution flags, symptom recovery, local lesion outcome, and best index-course systemic response remain distinct. Coded additional-treatment local assessment context identifies radiation, salvage, or CAR-T; NOT_REPORTED does not establish absence of that treatment. Clinical qualification narratives are excluded.

def format_coverage_missingness() -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    result = []
    for row in read("coverage"):
        result.append({"Domain": "Site ascertainment", "Scenario": "Primary eligibility", "Group or site": row["site"],
            "Measure": "Recorded flare ascertainment", "Total": row["eligible_courses"], "Evaluable": row["known_flare_status"],
            "Unavailable": row["unknown_flare"], "Detail": f"Master courses: {row['master_courses']}; original flare flags: {row['original_flags']}; returned records: {row['returned_records']}; returned suspected cases: {row['returned_candidates']}"})
    for row in read("missingness"):
        result.append({"Domain": "Variable availability", "Scenario": row["scenario"], "Group or site": row["group"],
            "Measure": row["field"], "Total": row["total"], "Evaluable": row["evaluable"], "Unavailable": row["unavailable"], "Detail": ""})
    return result

Table S3. Comparative response and post-treatment events

Full best-response categories, response thresholds, CRS, ICANS, prophylactic and therapeutic tocilizumab, hospital duration, and infections within 30 days are described with their evaluable denominators. Hospital duration uses recorded total days among admitted courses and does not estimate flare-attributable duration. CRS, ICANS, supportive treatment, hospitalization, and infection are post-treatment events; these comparisons do not establish baseline risk or temporal precedence.

def format_comparisons() -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    result: list[dict[str, str]] = []
    def count_value(n: str, denom: str) -> str:
        return f"{number(n, 0)}/{number(denom, 0)} ({number(str(100 * float(n) / float(denom)))}%)" if float(denom) else "Not available"
    for name, domain, measure_key in (("response_distribution", "Best response distribution", "category"),
                                      ("response_thresholds", "Best response thresholds", "threshold")):
        combined: OrderedDict[tuple[str, str], dict[str, str]] = OrderedDict()
        for row in read(name):
            measure = {"pr": ">=PR", "vgpr": ">=VGPR", "cr": "CR/sCR"}.get(row[measure_key], row[measure_key])
            key = row["scenario"], measure
            if key not in combined:
                combined[key] = {"Domain": domain, "Scenario": row["scenario"], "Measure": measure,
                    "Flare candidate": "", "No included flare": "", "Test": "", "P value": "", "Qualification": "Best index-course response; authoritative unknowns remain unavailable"}
            numerator = row.get("responders", row.get("n", "0"))
            is_unknown = measure.lower() in ("ne/unknown", "unknown", "unavailable", "ne")
            denominator = row["total_courses"] if is_unknown else row["evaluable"]
            combined[key][row["group"]] = count_value(numerator, denominator)
        result.extend(combined.values())
    for row in read("clinical_comparisons"):
        result.append({"Domain": "Post-treatment events", "Scenario": row["scenario"], "Measure": row["label"],
            "Flare candidate": count_value(row["flare_yes"], row["flare_evaluable"]),
            "No included flare": count_value(row["comparison_yes"], row["comparison_evaluable"]),
            "Test": "Fisher exact", "P value": number(row["fisher_p"], 4), "Qualification": row["interpretation"]})
    combined = OrderedDict()
    for row in read("hospitalization"):
        key = row["scenario"]
        if key not in combined:
            combined[key] = {"Domain": "Hospital duration among admissions", "Scenario": key, "Measure": "Days, median (IQR)",
                "Flare candidate": "", "No included flare": "", "Test": "Wilcoxon rank-sum", "P value": number(row["wilcoxon_p"], 4),
                "Qualification": row["definition"] + "; " + row["test_status"]}
        combined[key][row["group"]] = f"{number(row['median'])} ({number(row['q1'])}–{number(row['q3'])}); available {number(row['admitted_evaluable'],0)}/{number(row['total_courses'],0)}"
    result.extend(combined.values())
    return result

Table S4. Baseline laboratory and response association models

All prespecified exploratory Firth logistic models and sensitivity populations are shown with course and patient-cluster counts, flare events, estimates, confidence intervals, and bootstrap diagnostics. Baseline variables are assessed independently for association with documented suspected flare. Adjusted response models use six prespecified baseline covariates. Laboratory tests include Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment. Inference follows the canonical successful-resample threshold and is suppressed when estimation criteria are not met.

def format_models() -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    source = read("models")
    columns = ("model_id", "scenario", "family", "label", "response", "adjustment",
               "n_courses", "n_patient_clusters", "candidates", "events", "candidate_events",
               "excluded_missing", "estimate", "conf_low", "conf_high", "p_value", "lab_bh_p",
               "bootstrap_successes", "bootstrap_requested", "bootstrap_seed", "model_status", "diagnostic", "sparse_note")
    return [{key: row.get(key, "") for key in columns} for row in source]

Table S5. Time-dependent and landmark survival models

PFS and OS models show exposure-only, corresponding complete-case, and adjusted analyses with population and event counts, confidence intervals, endpoint qualifications, and proportional-hazards diagnostics. Suspected flare becomes an exposure at recorded onset. Sensitivities examine confidence classification, source-supported alternative onset, and day-30/day-60 landmarks. Unknown authoritative endpoints are excluded from affected analyses rather than replaced with conflicting master values. The original-master-endpoint analysis is labeled as a historical audit of superseded values and is not a clinically valid sensitivity analysis.

def format_survival() -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    result = []
    for name, domain in (("survival_models", "Time-dependent exposure"), ("landmark_models", "Landmark sensitivity")):
        for row in read(name):
            if row.get("scenario") == "original_master_endpoints":
                result.append({"Analysis": "Historical audit of superseded master endpoints", **row})
            else:
                result.append({"Analysis": domain, **row})
    return sorted(result, key=lambda row: row.get("scenario") == "original_master_endpoints")

flow_panel <- function(x, title) {
  stopifnot(all(c("label", "n") %in% names(x)))
  x <- x %>% mutate(y = rev(seq_len(n())), text = paste0(label, "\n", format(n, big.mark = ",")))
  p <- ggplot() + theme_void(base_family = font_family) +
    ggtitle(title) + theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11, hjust = 0),
                          plot.margin = margin(8, 8, 8, 8))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(x))) {
    p <- p + box_layer(0, x$y[i], 4.6, .72, x$text[i], size = 3.1)
    if (i < nrow(x)) p <- p + arrow_layer(0, x$y[i] - .36, 0, x$y[i+1] + .38)
  }
  p + coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-2.5, 2.5), ylim = c(.45, max(x$y) + .6), expand = FALSE)
}
comparative_flow_panel <- function(x) {
  if (nrow(x) < 6L) stop("Comparative flow requires four sequential stages and two terminal groups")
  stages <- x[seq_len(nrow(x) - 2L), ]
  groups <- x[(nrow(x)-1L):nrow(x), ]
  stages <- stages %>% mutate(y = rev(seq_len(n())) + 1.5)
  p <- ggplot() + theme_void(base_family = font_family) +
    ggtitle(panel_title("A", "Comparative cohort")) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11, hjust = 0), plot.margin = margin(8, 8, 8, 8))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(stages))) {
    p <- p + box_layer(0, stages$y[i], 4.6, .72,
                      paste0(stages$label[i], "\n", format(stages$n[i], big.mark = ",")), size = 3.1)
    if (i < nrow(stages)) p <- p + arrow_layer(0, stages$y[i] - .36, 0, stages$y[i+1] + .38)
  }
  for (i in 1:2) {
    xx <- if (i == 1L) -1.3 else 1.3
    p <- p + arrow_layer(0, min(stages$y) - .36, xx, 1.42) +
      box_layer(xx, 1.0, 2.35, .82, paste0(groups$label[i], "\n", format(groups$n[i], big.mark = ",")), size = 2.9)
  }
  p + coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-2.6, 2.6), ylim = c(.4, max(stages$y) + .6), expand = FALSE)
}
case_series_flow_panel <- function(x) {
  if (nrow(x) != 7L) stop("Case-series flow requires reviewed total, three confidence groups, and three eligibility groups")
  confidence_text <- paste0(x$label[2:4], ": ", format(x$n[2:4], big.mark = ","), collapse = "\n")
  eligibility_text <- paste0(x$label[5:7], ": ", format(x$n[5:7], big.mark = ","), collapse = "\n")
  ggplot() +
    box_layer(0, 5.8, 4.6, .85, paste0(x$label[1], "\n", format(x$n[1], big.mark = ",")), size = 3.2) +
    arrow_layer(0, 5.37, 0, 4.92) +
    box_layer(0, 4.2, 4.6, 1.45, paste0("Investigator confidence\n", confidence_text), size = 3.2) +
    arrow_layer(0, 3.47, 0, 2.98) +
    box_layer(0, 2.2, 4.6, 1.55, paste0("Comparative eligibility\n", eligibility_text), size = 3.2) +
    annotate("text", x = 0, y = .85, label = "All site-reviewed courses contribute to the descriptive case series.",
             family = font_family, size = 2.65) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-2.6, 2.6), ylim = c(.4, 6.6), expand = FALSE) +
    theme_void(base_family = font_family) + ggtitle(panel_title("B", "Site-reviewed case series")) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11, hjust = 0), plot.margin = margin(8, 8, 8, 8))
}

Figure 2. Onset and recorded clinical chronology

Panel A shows the empirical cumulative distribution among cases with point onset timing. Panel B uses neutral case rows to show onset, recorded peak, and recorded symptom-resolution days after first step-up dosing. Open markers indicate estimated dates; an onset interval is drawn as an interval without an inferred midpoint. Markers beyond day 100 are placed at the right boundary with a greater-than mark; elapsed values are supplied in Table S1. A missing resolution date does not imply persistent flare. Confidence and bridging status are shown separately.

Relevant literature: Forsberg 2024; Nagarajan 2024; Jadot 2026.

Figure 3. Clinical manifestations impact and index anatomy

Panels A-C describe six manifestation domains, clinical complications and flare-attributed admission, and index anatomical involvement. Domains overlap, and each uses the complete site-reviewed denominator with Yes, No, Unknown, and Not applicable categories. Unknown and Not applicable are separate states. Labels give the Yes count over the total case-series denominator. True extramedullary disease is distinguished from paraskeletal involvement. Spinal and CNS involvement are separate overlapping descriptors; spinal involvement does not by itself imply CNS disease.

Relevant literature: Forsberg 2024; Khan 2025; Kawatsuki 2026; Ito 2026; Takakuwa 2026.

status_bars <- function(x, title) {
  stopifnot(all(c("label", "category", "n", "denominator") %in% names(x)))
  x <- x %>% mutate(category = ifelse(is.na(category) | category == "", "Unknown", category))
  if (!all(x$category %in% names(colours))) stop("Unexpected clinical status category")
  labels <- unique(x$label)
  x <- x %>% mutate(label = factor(label, levels = rev(labels)), category = factor(category, levels = names(colours)), proportion = n/denominator)
  yes <- x %>% filter(category == "Yes")
  ggplot(x, aes(proportion, label, fill = category)) + geom_col(width = .64, position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE), colour = "white", linewidth = .25, show.legend = TRUE) +
    geom_text(data = yes, aes(x = 1.02, y = label, label = paste0(n, "/", denominator)), inherit.aes = FALSE,
              hjust = 0, size = 3.0, family = font_family) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colours, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1), breaks = c(0, .25, .5, .75, 1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1.14), clip = "off") +
    labs(title = title, x = "Proportion of site-reviewed cases", y = NULL) + theme_paper(9.5) +
    theme(axis.line.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank())
}

Figure 4. Exploratory associations with suspected flare response and survival

Panel A shows six independent Firth logistic baseline models for documented suspected flare. Panel B shows adjusted best-response thresholds, and panel C shows adjusted time-dependent PFS and OS associations. Each row provides its estimate, 95% confidence interval, and actual analysis population. Baseline ORs, response ORs, and survival HRs have different outcomes and are displayed separately. Six-covariate adjustment includes age, sex, ECOG performance status, prior treatment lines, high-risk cytogenetics, and true extramedullary disease. Sparse events, missing covariates, post-treatment classification, and wide intervals limit inference; absence of a clear association does not establish equivalence.

forest <- function(x, title, metric) {
  stopifnot(all(c("label", "estimate", "conf_low", "conf_high", "n_courses", "candidates") %in% names(x)))
  x <- x %>% mutate(row = rev(row_number()))
  rng <- range(c(x$conf_low, x$conf_high, 1), na.rm = TRUE)
  rng <- c(max(.01, rng[1] * .8), rng[2] * 1.2)
  labels <- ggplot(x, aes(y = row)) + geom_text(aes(x = 0, label = label), hjust = 0, family = font_family, size = 3.0) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(.35, nrow(x) + .65), clip = "off") + theme_void() + theme(plot.margin = margin(4, 2, 4, 2))
  values <- x %>% mutate(value = ifelse(is.finite(estimate), sprintf("%.2f (%.2f-%.2f)", estimate, conf_low, conf_high), "Not estimated"),
    population = paste0("N=", format(n_courses, big.mark = ","), "; flare=", candidates))
  right <- ggplot(values, aes(y = row)) + geom_text(aes(x = 0, label = value), hjust = 0, family = font_family, size = 3.0) +
    geom_text(aes(x = .60, label = population), hjust = 0, family = font_family, size = 2.75) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1.35), ylim = c(.35, nrow(x) + .65), clip = "off") + theme_void() + theme(plot.margin = margin(4, 2, 4, 2))
  center <- ggplot(x, aes(estimate, row)) + geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "#89949C", linewidth = .4) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = conf_low, xmax = conf_high), orientation = "y", width = .12, linewidth = .55, na.rm = TRUE) +
    geom_point(size = 2.1, colour = "#1B5678", na.rm = TRUE) + scale_x_log10(limits = rng) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(.35, nrow(x) + .65)) + labs(x = paste0(metric, " (95% CI)"), y = NULL) + theme_paper(8.5) +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), axis.line.y = element_blank(),
          plot.margin = margin(4, 4, 4, 4))
  (labels + center + right + plot_layout(widths = c(1.05, 1.0, 1.55))) +
    plot_annotation(title = title, theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(family = font_family, face = "bold", size = 11)))
}

Figure 5. Proposed clinical recognition and reassessment framework

The proposed framework prioritizes urgent complications, competing explanations, and integration of clinical, biochemical, and imaging evidence. Treatment decisions are individualized rather than determined by a mandatory continuation rule. Longitudinal reassessment records symptom recovery, local lesion outcome, and systemic response separately. This framework is derived from the cohort and literature and has not undergone formal consensus validation or prospective diagnostic evaluation.

Relevant literature: Forsberg 2024; Nagarajan 2024; Khan 2025; Daunov 2026; Jadot 2026; Biltibo 2026; Lee 2019; Kumar 2016.

recognition_framework <- function() {
  ggplot() +
    box_layer(4.7, 9.2, 8.0, 1.05,
              "New focal pain, swelling, or apparent lesion worsening\nafter bispecific antibody initiation") +
    arrow_layer(4.7, 8.67, 4.7, 8.18) +
    box_layer(4.7, 7.55, 8.0, 1.25,
              "Assess immediately for urgent complications\nNeurological compromise, cord compression, fracture,\norgan dysfunction, or hemodynamic instability", "#FAECEA") +
    arrow_layer(4.7, 6.92, 4.7, 6.42) +
    box_layer(4.7, 5.73, 8.0, 1.35,
              "Evaluate competing explanations\nTrue progression, infection, CRS or ICANS, structural injury,\nand other treatment-related or unrelated causes") +
    arrow_layer(4.7, 5.05, 4.7, 4.52) +
    box_layer(4.7, 3.80, 8.0, 1.4,
              "Integrate evidence and individualize treatment\nClinical course, biochemical trajectory, imaging, and biopsy when feasible\nAddress complications and symptoms; reassess the risks and benefits\nof continuing, interrupting, or changing therapy") +
    arrow_layer(4.7, 3.09, 4.7, 2.55) +
    box_layer(4.7, 1.78, 8.0, 1.5,
              "Reassess longitudinally\nDocument symptom recovery, local lesion outcome, and systemic response\nseparately; record treatment changes and unresolved attribution\nRevise the working diagnosis as evidence develops", "#EAF2F5") +
    annotate("text", x = 4.7, y = .38,
             label = "Proposed clinical framework; diagnostic criteria and treatment decisions require prospective validation.",
             family = font_family, size = 3.1, colour = "#333333") +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(.2, 9.2), ylim = c(0, 10), expand = FALSE) +
    theme_void(base_family = font_family) + theme(plot.margin = margin(12, 10, 10, 10))
}
save_figure(recognition_framework(), "Figure_5_Recognition_framework", 8.5, 9.0)
save_display_data(data.frame(step = 1:5,
  action = c("Recognize new focal symptoms or apparent lesion worsening", "Assess urgent complications",
             "Evaluate competing explanations", "Integrate evidence and individualize treatment",
             "Reassess longitudinally"), validation = "Proposed framework"), "Figure_5")

Publication module: build_figures.R. Verification: canonical analysis and display checks.

Figure S1. Landmark progression-free and overall survival
PFS and OS are shown at day-30 and day-60 landmarks with 95% confidence bands and numbers at risk. Follow-up restarts at the landmark. Flare exposure is defined only by onset on or before that landmark; courses developing flare later remain in the no-flare-by-landmark group for that analysis. Patients must be alive and, for PFS, progression-free at the landmark. These descriptive curves condition on landmark eligibility and do not replace the time-dependent primary models.
Download PDF Download PNG
Executable code for Figure S1
km <- read_input("landmark_km_steps", c("endpoint", "landmark_day", "group", "time", "survival", "lower", "upper"))
risk <- read_input("landmark_risk_counts", c("endpoint", "landmark_day", "group", "time", "n_risk"))
group_label <- function(x) ifelse(as.character(x) == "0", "No flare by landmark", ifelse(as.character(x) == "1", "Flare by landmark", as.character(x)))
km <- km %>% mutate(group = group_label(group))
risk <- risk %>% mutate(group = group_label(group))
group_colours <- c("No flare by landmark" = "#65747E", "Flare by landmark" = "#1B5678")
landmark_panel <- function(endpoint_value, day_value, letter) {
  x <- km %>% filter(endpoint == endpoint_value, landmark_day == day_value)
  r <- risk %>% filter(endpoint == endpoint_value, landmark_day == day_value)
  stopifnot(nrow(x) > 0, nrow(r) > 0)
  xmax <- max(r$time)
  x <- x %>% arrange(group, time)
  step_band <- x %>% group_by(group) %>% mutate(next_time = lead(time)) %>% ungroup()
  step_band <- bind_rows(step_band %>% mutate(order = 1), step_band %>% filter(is.finite(next_time)) %>% mutate(time = next_time, order = 0)) %>% arrange(group, time, order)
  # Canonical landmark KM and risk-count time fields are elapsed months.
  p <- ggplot(x, aes(time, survival, colour = group, fill = group)) +
    geom_ribbon(data = step_band, aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = .12, colour = NA) + geom_step(linewidth = .65) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = group_colours) + scale_fill_manual(values = group_colours) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1)) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = sort(unique(r$time)), labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 1)) + coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, xmax)) +
    labs(title = panel_title(letter, paste0(endpoint_value, " at day ", day_value)), x = "Months after landmark", y = paste0(endpoint_value, " probability")) +
    theme_paper(9) + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  groups <- c("Flare by landmark", "No flare by landmark")
  r <- r %>% mutate(row = match(group, rev(groups)))
  rt <- ggplot(r, aes(time, row, label = n_risk, colour = group)) + geom_text(family = font_family, size = 2.7) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = group_colours) + scale_x_continuous(breaks = sort(unique(r$time))) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = 1:2, labels = rev(groups)) + coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, xmax), ylim = c(.4, 2.6), clip = "off") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = "Number at risk") + theme_void(base_family = font_family) +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7, hjust = 1), plot.title = element_text(size = 8.5, hjust = 0),
          plot.margin = margin(3, 10, 3, 8), legend.position = "none")
  p / rt + plot_layout(heights = c(4.2, 1))
}
save_figure(wrap_plots(list(
              wrap_elements(full = landmark_panel("PFS", 30, "A")),
              wrap_elements(full = landmark_panel("OS", 30, "B")),
              wrap_elements(full = landmark_panel("PFS", 60, "C")),
              wrap_elements(full = landmark_panel("OS", 60, "D"))), ncol = 2, nrow = 2),
            "Figure_S1_Landmark_survival", 12, 9.5)
save_display_data(km, "Figure_S1_KM")
save_display_data(risk, "Figure_S1_Risk")
